      package payments
      
      import (

        "encoding/json"
        "fmt"

        "github.com/BUCC-Backend-Team/payment_service_4/internal/database"
        "github.com/google/uuid"
      )
      
      type callbackEnvelope struct {
        ID        uuid.UUID       `json:"id"`
        Type      string          `json:"type"`
        CreatedAt string          `json:"createdAt"`
        Data      callbackPayload `json:"data"`
      }
      
      type callbackPayload struct {
        PaymentID      string `json:"paymentId"`
        OrderID        string `json:"orderId"`
        Status         string `json:"status"`
        Amount         int64  `json:"amount"`
        AmountRefunded int64  `json:"amountRefunded"`
        Currency       string `json:"currency"`
        Late           bool   `json:"late"`
      }
      
      func enqueuePaymentCallbackTx(
        ctx context.Context,
        q *database.Queries,
        p database.Payment,
        eventType string,
        status string,
        late bool,
      ) error {
        refunded, err := int64FromAny(q.SumProcessedRefunds(ctx, p.ID))
        if err != nil {
          return fmt.Errorf("sum refunds for callback: %w", err)
        }
      
        id := uuid.New()
      
        envelope := callbackEnvelope{
          ID:        id,
          Type:      eventType,
          CreatedAt: time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
          Data: callbackPayload{
            PaymentID:      p.ID.String(),
            OrderID:        p.OrderID,
            Status:         status,
            Amount:         p.Amount,
            AmountRefunded: refunded,
            Currency:       p.Currency,
            Late:           late,
          },
        }
      
        raw, err := json.Marshal(envelope)
        if err != nil {
          return fmt.Errorf("encode callback payload: %w", err)
        }
      
        if _, err := q.EnqueueCallback(ctx, database.EnqueueCallbackParams{
          ID:      id,
          Type:    eventType,
          Payload: raw,
        }); err != nil {
          return fmt.Errorf("write callback to outbox: %w", err)
        }
      
        return nil
      }
      
      func signCallback(secret string, ts time.Time, body []byte) string {
        stringToSign := strconv.FormatInt(ts.Unix(), 10) + "." + string(body)
        mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte(secret))
        mac.Write([]byte(stringToSign))
        return fmt.Sprintf("t=%d,v1=%s", ts.Unix(), hex.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil)))
      }
      
      const (
        callbackMaxAttempts   = 60
        callbackBaseBackoff   = 1.0 // seconds
        callbackMaxBackoff    = 120.0
        callbackBatchSize     = 20
        callbackHTTPTimeout   = 10 * time.Second
      )
      
      func StartCallbackDeliveryWorker(ctx context.Context, interval time.Duration) {
        if cfg == nil || cfg.db == nil || cfg.callbackURL == "" {
          return
        }
        if interval <= 0 {
          interval = defaultCallbackInterval
        }
      
        cfg.logger.Info("callback delivery worker started")
      
        client := &http.Client{Timeout: callbackHTTPTimeout}
        ticker := time.NewTicker(interval)
        defer ticker.Stop()
      
        for {
          select {
          case <-ctx.Done():
            return
          case <-ticker.C:
            deliverDueCallbacks(ctx, client)
          }
        }
      }
      
      func deliverDueCallbacks(ctx context.Context, client *http.Client) {
        rows, err := cfg.db.ListDueCallbacks(ctx, database.ListDueCallbacksParams{
          Attempts: int32(callbackMaxAttempts),
          Limit:    callbackBatchSize,
        })
        if err != nil {
          if cfg.logger != nil {
            cfg.logger.Error("failed to list due callbacks", "error", err)
          }
          return
        }
      
        for _, row := range rows {
          if ctx.Err() != nil {
            return
          }
      
          body := []byte(row.Payload)
          delivered := deliverCallback(ctx, client, body)
      
          if delivered {
            if err := cfg.db.MarkCallbackDelivered(ctx, row.ID); err != nil {
              if cfg.logger != nil {
                cfg.logger.Error("failed to mark callback delivered", "id", row.ID, "error", err)
              }
            }
            continue
          }
      
          // Exponential backoff: attempt 0→1s, 1→2s, 2→4s ... capped.
          shift := int(row.Attempts)
          if shift > 7 {
            shift = 7
          }
          delay := callbackBaseBackoff * float64(int64(1)<<shift)
          if delay > callbackMaxBackoff {
            delay = callbackMaxBackoff
          }
      
          if err := cfg.db.MarkCallbackFailed(ctx, database.MarkCallbackFailedParams{
            ID:   row.ID,
            Secs: delay,
          }); err != nil {
            if cfg.logger != nil {
              cfg.logger.Error("failed to schedule callback retry", "id", row.ID, "error", err)
            }
          }
        }
      }
      
      func deliverCallback(ctx context.Context, client *http.Client, body []byte) bool {
        ts := time.Now()
        req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, cfg.callbackURL, bytes.NewReader(body))
        if err != nil {
          if cfg.logger != nil {
            cfg.logger.Error("failed to build callback request", "error", err)
          }
          return false
        }
      
        req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
        req.Header.Set("X-MarketlySignature", signCallback(cfg.callbackSecret, ts, body))
      
        resp, err := client.Do(req)
        if err != nil {
          if cfg.logger != nil {
            cfg.logger.Warn("callback delivery failed", "error", err)
          }
          return false
        }
        defer resp.Body.Close()
        _, _ = io.Copy(io.Discard, resp.Body)
      
        return resp.StatusCode >= 200 && resp.StatusCode <= 299
      }

      package payments
      
      import (
        "encoding/json"
        "errors"
        "net/http"
        "strconv"
        "strings"
      
        "github.com/google/uuid"
      )
      
      func writeJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, data any, headers ...string) {
        for i := 0; i+1 < len(headers); i += 2 {
          w.Header().Set(headers[i], headers[i+1])
        }
      
        w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
        w.WriteHeader(status)
      
        if err := json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(data); err != nil {
          return
        }
      }
      
      func writeAPIError(w http.ResponseWriter, err error) {
        var ae apiError
        if errors.As(err, &ae) {
          writeJSON(w, ae.Status, map[string]string{"error": ae.Code})
          return
        }
      
        status := http.StatusInternalServerError
        message := "failed to initialize payment"
      
        msg := err.Error()
        switch {
        case strings.Contains(msg, "payment service is not initialized"):
          status = http.StatusInternalServerError
          message = "failed to initialize payment"
        case strings.Contains(msg, "order ID, idempotency key, customer email"),
          strings.Contains(msg, "a valid customer email"),
          strings.Contains(msg, "currency must be"),
          strings.Contains(msg, "idempotency key not provided"),
          strings.Contains(msg, "payment id not provided"),
          strings.Contains(msg, "invalid payment id"),
          strings.Contains(msg, "amount must be"),
          strings.Contains(msg, " ecommerce"):
          status = http.StatusBadRequest
          message = msg
        }
      
        writeJSON(w, status, map[string]string{"error": message})
      }
      
      func MakePaymentHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
        if !authenticateMerchant(w, r) {
          return
        }
        defer r.Body.Close()
      
        var req MakePaymentRequest
        idempotencyKey := r.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key")
        if idempotencyKey == "" {
          writeJSON(w, http.StatusBadRequest, map[string]string{
            "error": "idempotency key not provided",
          })
          return
        }
      
        decoder := json.NewDecoder(r.Body)
        decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
      
        if err := decoder.Decode(&req); err != nil {
          writeJSON(w, http.StatusBadRequest, map[string]string{
            "error": "invalid JSON request body",
          })
          return
        }
      
        if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, http.ErrBodyReadAfterClose) && err == nil {
          writeJSON(w, http.StatusBadRequest, map[string]string{
            "error": "request body must contain only one JSON object",
          })
          return
        } else if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, errors.New("EOF")) {
          if strings.TrimSpace(err.Error()) != "EOF" {
            writeJSON(w, http.StatusBadRequest, map[string]string{
              "error": "request body must contain only one JSON object",
            })
            return
          }
        }
      
        req.IdempotencyKey = idempotencyKey
      
        if strings.TrimSpace(req.OrderID) == "" ||
          strings.TrimSpace(req.CustomerEmail) == "" ||
          req.Amount <= 0 {
          writeJSON(w, http.StatusBadRequest, map[string]string{
            "error": "order_id, customer_email, and a positive amount are required",
          })
          return
        }
      
        response, err := makePayment(r.Context(), req)
        if err != nil {
          cfg.logger.Error("failed to initialize payment", "err", err)
          writeAPIError(w, err)
          return
        }
      
        headers := make([]string, 0, 2)
        if response.Replayed {
          headers = append(headers, "Idempotent-Replayed", "true")
        }
      
        writeJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, response, headers...)
      }
      
      func GetPaymentByIdHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
        if !authenticateMerchant(w, r) {
          return
        }
        defer r.Body.Close()
      
        paymentId := r.PathValue("id")
      
        payment, err := GetPaymentByID(r.Context(), paymentId)
        if err != nil {
          var ae apiError
          if errors.As(err, &ae) {
            writeJSON(w, ae.Status, map[string]string{"error": ae.Code})
            return
          }
      
          cfg.logger.Error("failed to fetch payment", "err", err)
          status := http.StatusInternalServerError
          message := "failed to fetch payment"
      
          msg := err.Error()
          switch {
          case strings.Contains(msg, "payment id not provided"),
            strings.Contains(msg, "invalid payment id"):
            status = http.StatusBadRequest
            message = msg
          }
      
          writeJSON(w, status, map[string]string{"error": message})
          return
        }
      
        writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, payment)
      }
      
      func RefundPaymentHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
        if !authenticateMerchant(w, r) {
          return
        }
        defer r.Body.Close()
      
        idempotencyKey := r.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key")
        if idempotencyKey == "" {
          writeJSON(w, http.StatusBadRequest, map[string]string{
            "error": "idempotency key not provided",
          })
          return
        }
      
        paymentID, err := uuid.Parse(r.PathValue("id"))
        if err != nil {
          writeJSON(w, http.StatusBadRequest, map[string]string{
            "error": "invalid payment id",
          })
          return
        }
      
        var req CreateRefundRequest
        req.IdempotencyKey = idempotencyKey
      
        if r.ContentLength > 0 {
          var body struct {
            Amount *int64 `json:"amount"`
          }
          decoder := json.NewDecoder(r.Body)
          decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
          if err := decoder.Decode(&body); err != nil {
            writeJSON(w, http.StatusBadRequest, map[string]string{
              "error": "invalid JSON request body",
            })
            return
          }
          if body.Amount != nil {
            req.Amount = *body.Amount
          }
        }
      
        response, err := createRefund(r.Context(), paymentID, req)
        if err != nil {
          var ae apiError
          if errors.As(err, &ae) {
            writeJSON(w, ae.Status, map[string]string{"error": ae.Code})
            return
          }
          cfg.logger.Error("failed to create refund", "err", err)
          writeAPIError(w, err)
          return
        }
      
        headers := make([]string, 0, 2)
        if response.Replayed {
          headers = append(headers, "Idempotent-Replayed", "true")
        }
      
        writeJSON(w, http.StatusAccepted, response, headers...)
      }
      
      func HandleAdminReset(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
        if !authenticateMerchant(w, r) {
          return
        }
        defer r.Body.Close()
      
        if !cfg.testMode {
          writeJSON(w, http.StatusForbidden, map[string]string{
            "error": "admin reset is only available when TEST_MODE=true",
          })
          return
        }
      
        if err := cfg.db.ResetAll(r.Context()); err != nil {
          cfg.logger.Error("admin reset failed", "err", err)
          writeJSON(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, map[string]string{
            "error": "failed to reset data",
          })
          return
        }
      
        cfg.logger.Info("admin reset completed")
        w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
      }

      package payments
      
      import (
        "context"
        "database/sql"
        "encoding/json"
        "errors"
        "fmt"
        "strings"
        "time"
      
        "github.com/BUCC-Backend-Team/payment_service_4/internal/database"
        "github.com/google/uuid"
      )
      
      type MakePaymentRequest struct {
        OrderID        string `json:"orderId"`
        IdempotencyKey string `json:"Idempotency-Key"`
        Amount         int64  `json:"amount"`
        CustomerEmail  string `json:"customerEmail"`
        ReturnUrl      string `json:"returnUrl"`
        Currency       string `json:"currency"`
      }
      
      type MakePaymentResponse struct {
        PaymentID   string `json:"paymentId"`
        OrderID     string `json:"orderId"`
        Status      string `json:"status"`
        Amount      int64  `json:"amount"`
        Currency    string `json:"currency"`
        CheckoutURL string `json:"checkoutUrl"`
        Replayed    bool   `json:"-"`
      }
      
      func makePayment(ctx context.Context, req MakePaymentRequest) (MakePaymentResponse, error) {
        if cfg == nil || cfg.db == nil {
          return MakePaymentResponse{}, errors.New("payment service is not initialized")
        }
      
        req.OrderID = strings.TrimSpace(req.OrderID)
        req.IdempotencyKey = strings.TrimSpace(req.IdempotencyKey)
        req.CustomerEmail = strings.TrimSpace(req.CustomerEmail)
        req.ReturnUrl = strings.TrimSpace(req.ReturnUrl)
      
        if req.OrderID == "" ||
          req.IdempotencyKey == "" ||
          req.CustomerEmail == "" ||
          req.Amount <= 0 {
          return MakePaymentResponse{}, errors.New("order ID, idempotency key, customer email, and positive amount are required")
        }
      
        if strings.ContainsAny(req.CustomerEmail, " \t\r\n") ||
          !strings.Contains(req.CustomerEmail, "@") {
          return MakePaymentResponse{}, errors.New("a valid customer email is required")
        }
      
        if req.ReturnUrl == "" {
          return MakePaymentResponse{}, errors.New("order ID, idempotency key, customer email, and positive amount are required")
        }
      
        currency := "NGN"
        if req.Currency != "" && req.Currency != "NGN" {
          return MakePaymentResponse{}, errors.New("currency must be NGN")
        }
      
        key := paymentIdempotencyPrefix + req.IdempotencyKey
        requestHash := idempotencyRequestHash(req.OrderID, fmt.Sprintf("%d", req.Amount), currency, req.CustomerEmail, req.ReturnUrl)
      
        ownsIt, existing, err := reserveIdempotencyKey(ctx, key, requestHash)
        if err != nil {
          return MakePaymentResponse{}, fmt.Errorf("reserve idempotency key: %w", err)
        }
      
        if !ownsIt {
          if existing.RequestHash != requestHash {
            return MakePaymentResponse{}, newAPIError(422, "idempotency key was already used with a different request body")
          }
      
          if existing.ResponseBody != "" {
            var stored MakePaymentResponse
            if err := decodeIdempotencyResponse(existing.ResponseBody, &stored); err != nil {
              return MakePaymentResponse{}, fmt.Errorf("decode stored idempotency response: %w", err)
            }
            stored.Replayed = true
            return stored, nil
          }
      
          payment, lookupErr := cfg.db.GetPaymentByIdempotencyKey(ctx, req.IdempotencyKey)
          switch {
          case lookupErr == nil && payment.Status == "pending":
            return finishPaymentInit(ctx, payment, requestHash)
          case lookupErr != nil && !errors.Is(lookupErr, sql.ErrNoRows):
            return MakePaymentResponse{}, fmt.Errorf("reload pending payment: %w", lookupErr)
          }
      
          found, pollErr := pollIdempotencyResponse(ctx, key, 10*time.Second)
          if pollErr != nil {
            return MakePaymentResponse{}, fmt.Errorf("wait for concurrent request: %w", pollErr)
          }
          if found {
            var stored MakePaymentResponse
            if err := idempotencyStoredResponse(ctx, key, &stored); err != nil {
              return MakePaymentResponse{}, fmt.Errorf("decode stored idempotency response: %w", err)
            }
            stored.Replayed = true
            return stored, nil
          }
        }
      
        paymentID := uuid.New()
      
        q := database.New(cfg.DB)
        created, err := q.CreatePayment(ctx, database.CreatePaymentParams{
          ID:                paymentID,
          IdempotencyKey:    req.IdempotencyKey,
          OrderID:           req.OrderID,
          Amount:            req.Amount,
          Currency:          currency,
          CustomerEmail:     req.CustomerEmail,
          PaystackReference: paymentID.String(),
          ReturnUrl:         req.ReturnUrl,
          ExpiresAt:         sql.NullTime{Time: time.Now().Add(cfg.expiresIn), Valid: true},
        })
      
        if err != nil {
          if isUniqueViolation(err) {
            releaseIdempotencyKey(ctx, key)
            return MakePaymentResponse{}, classifyCreatePaymentConflict(err)
          }
          releaseIdempotencyKey(ctx, key)
          return MakePaymentResponse{}, fmt.Errorf("create payment: %w", err)
        }
      
        return finishPaymentInit(ctx, created, requestHash)
      }
      
      
      func finishPaymentInit(
        ctx context.Context,
        payment database.Payment,
        requestHash string,
      ) (MakePaymentResponse, error) {
        log := cfg.logger
        if log == nil {
          log = discardLogger()
        }
      
        key := paymentIdempotencyPrefix + payment.IdempotencyKey
      
        ca, err := chargeAuthorization(ctx, payment.Amount, payment.CustomerEmail, payment.PaystackReference)
        if err != nil {
          vt, vtErr := verifyTransaction(ctx, payment.PaystackReference)
          if vtErr == nil &&
            vt.Status &&
            vt.Data.Status == "success" &&
            vt.Data.Amount == payment.Amount &&
            vt.Data.Currency == payment.Currency {
      
            late, markErr := markPaymentSucceededByReference(
              ctx,
              payment.PaystackReference,
              vt.Data.Channel,
              false,
            )
            if markErr != nil {
              log.Error("failed to mark recovered payment succeeded", "error", markErr)
              return MakePaymentResponse{}, newAPIError(502, "failed to initialize payment with Paystack")
            }
            if late != nil {
              payment = *late
            }
            payment.Status = "succeeded"
      
            resp := MakePaymentResponse{
              PaymentID: payment.ID.String(),
              OrderID:   payment.OrderID,
              Status:    payment.Status,
              Amount:    payment.Amount,
              Currency:  payment.Currency,
            }
            storeInitResponseAfterRecovery(ctx, key, requestHash, resp)
            return resp, nil
          }
      
          log.Error("Paystack initialization failed", "reference", payment.PaystackReference, "error", err)
      
          return MakePaymentResponse{}, newAPIError(502, "failed to initialize payment with Paystack")
        }
      
        resp := MakePaymentResponse{
          PaymentID:   payment.ID.String(),
          OrderID:     payment.OrderID,
          Status:      payment.Status,
          Amount:      payment.Amount,
          Currency:    payment.Currency,
          CheckoutURL: ca.Data.AuthorizationUrl,
        }
      
        raw, err := json.Marshal(resp)
        if err != nil {
          return resp, fmt.Errorf("encode payment response: %w", err)
        }
      
        tx, err := cfg.DB.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
        if err != nil {
          return resp, fmt.Errorf("begin idempotency transaction: %w", err)
        }
        defer rollbackTx(tx)
      
        qtx := database.New(tx)
      
        if _, err := qtx.UpdatePaymentCheckout(ctx, database.UpdatePaymentCheckoutParams{
          ID:          payment.ID,
          CheckoutUrl: sql.NullString{String: ca.Data.AuthorizationUrl, Valid: true},
          AccessCode:  sql.NullString{String: ca.Data.AccessCode, Valid: ca.Data.AccessCode != ""},
        }); err != nil {
          return resp, fmt.Errorf("save payment checkout details: %w", err)
        }
      
        if err := storeIdempotencyResponse(ctx, qtx, key, 201, raw); err != nil {
          return resp, fmt.Errorf("store idempotency response: %w", err)
        }
      
        if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
          return resp, fmt.Errorf("commit idempotency transaction: %w", err)
        }
      
        return resp, nil
      }
      
      
      func storeInitResponseAfterRecovery(ctx context.Context, key, requestHash string, resp MakePaymentResponse) {
        raw, err := json.Marshal(resp)
        if err != nil {
          return
        }
        if err := cfg.db.UpdateIdempotencyResponse(ctx, database.UpdateIdempotencyResponseParams{
          Key:            key,
          ResponseBody:   string(raw),
          ResponseStatus: sqlNullInt32FromInt(201),
        }); err != nil {
          if cfg.logger != nil {
            cfg.logger.Error("failed to store recovered payment response", "error", err)
          }
        }
        _ = requestHash
      }
      
      type GetPaymentByIdResponse struct {
        Status         string `json:"status"`
        Channel        string `json:"channel"`
        AmountRefunded int64  `json:"amountRefunded"`
      }
      
      func GetPaymentByID(ctx context.Context, paymentId string) (GetPaymentByIdResponse, error) {
        if cfg == nil || cfg.db == nil {
          return GetPaymentByIdResponse{}, errors.New("payment service is not initialized")
        }
      
        if paymentId == "" {
          return GetPaymentByIdResponse{}, errors.New("payment id not provided")
        }
      
        pId, err := uuid.Parse(paymentId)
        if err != nil {
          return GetPaymentByIdResponse{}, errors.New("invalid payment id")
        }
      
        payment, err := cfg.db.GetPaymentById(ctx, pId)
        if err != nil {
          if errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows) {
            return GetPaymentByIdResponse{}, newAPIError(404, "payment not found")
          }
          return GetPaymentByIdResponse{}, errors.New("failed to fetch payment")
        }
      
        refunded, err := int64FromAny(cfg.db.SumProcessedRefunds(ctx, pId))
        if err != nil {
          return GetPaymentByIdResponse{}, errors.New("failed to fetch payment")
        }
      
        return GetPaymentByIdResponse{
          Status:         payment.Status,
          Channel:        payment.Channel.String,
          AmountRefunded: refunded,
        }, nil
      }

      package payments
      
      import (
        "context"
        "crypto/hmac"
        "crypto/sha512"
        "crypto/subtle"
        "database/sql"
        "encoding/hex"
        "encoding/json"
        "errors"
        "fmt"
        "io"
        "net/http"
        "strconv"
      
        "github.com/BUCC-Backend-Team/payment_service_4/internal/database"
      )
      
      type PaystackWebhookEvent struct {
        Event string `json:"event"`
        Data  struct {
          ID        int64           `json:"id"`
          Status    string          `json:"status"`
          Reference string          `json:"reference"`
          Amount    int64           `json:"amount"`
          Currency  string          `json:"currency"`
          Channel   string          `json:"channel"`
          Transaction struct {
            Reference string `json:"reference"`
            Amount    int64  `json:"amount"`
          } `json:"transaction"`
        } `json:"data"`
      }
      
      func HandleWebhook(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
        defer r.Body.Close()
      
        body, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(r.Body, 1<<20))
        if err != nil {
          http.Error(w, "invalid request body", http.StatusBadRequest)
          return
        }
      
        signature := r.Header.Get("x-paystack-signature")
        if signature == "" || cfg == nil || cfg.paystackSecretKey == "" {
          http.Error(w, "invalid signature", http.StatusBadRequest)
          return
        }
      
        mac := hmac.New(sha512.New, []byte(cfg.paystackSecretKey))
        mac.Write(body)
        expectedSignature := hex.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))
      
        if subtle.ConstantTimeCompare([]byte(expectedSignature), []byte(signature)) != 1 {
          cfg.logger.Warn("invalid paystack webhook signature")
          http.Error(w, "invalid signature", http.StatusBadRequest)
          return
        }
      
        var event PaystackWebhookEvent
        if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &event); err != nil {
          http.Error(w, "invalid webhook payload", http.StatusBadRequest)
          return
        }
      
        ctx := r.Context()
      
        switch event.Event {
        case "charge.success":
          handleChargeSuccess(ctx, w, event)
        case "refund.processed":
          handleRefundEvent(ctx, w, event, true)
        case "refund.failed":
          handleRefundEvent(ctx, w, event, false)
        default:
          w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
        }
      }
      
      
      func handleChargeSuccess(ctx context.Context, w http.ResponseWriter, event PaystackWebhookEvent) {
        d := event.Data
        if d.Reference == "" || d.Amount <= 0 || d.Currency == "" {
          http.Error(w, "invalid transaction data", http.StatusBadRequest)
          return
        }
      
        payment, err := cfg.db.GetPaymentByPaystackReference(ctx, d.Reference)
        if err != nil {
          if errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows) {
            cfg.logger.Warn("charge.success for unknown reference", "reference", d.Reference)
            w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
            return
          }
          cfg.logger.Error("failed to load payment for webhook", "error", err)
          http.Error(w, "internal error", http.StatusInternalServerError)
          return
        }
      
        vt, err := verifyTransaction(ctx, d.Reference)
        if err != nil || !vt.Status || vt.Data.Status != "success" ||
          vt.Data.Amount != payment.Amount ||
          vt.Data.Currency != payment.Currency {
          cfg.logger.Error("charge.success failed verification",
            "reference", d.Reference,
            "webhookStatus", d.Status,
            "verified", err == nil && vt.Status,
            "error", err,
          )
          w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
          return
        }
      
        dedupKey := webhookDedupKey(event)
      
        tx, err := cfg.DB.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
        if err != nil {
          cfg.logger.Error("failed to begin webhook transaction", "error", err)
          http.Error(w, "internal error", http.StatusInternalServerError)
          return
        }
        defer rollbackTx(tx)
      
        q := database.New(tx)
      
        if _, err := q.RecordProcessedWebhookEvent(ctx, dedupKey); err != nil {
          if !errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows) {
            cfg.logger.Error("failed to record webhook event", "error", err)
            http.Error(w, "internal error", http.StatusInternalServerError)
            return
          }
          rollbackTx(tx)
          w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
          return
        }
      
        late := payment.Status == "expired"
        updated, err := markPaymentSucceededTx(ctx, q, payment, vt.Data.Channel, late)
        if err != nil {
          cfg.logger.Error("failed to mark payment succeeded from webhook", "error", err)
          http.Error(w, "internal error", http.StatusInternalServerError)
          return
        }
        _ = updated
      
        if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
          cfg.logger.Error("failed to commit webhook transaction", "error", err)
          http.Error(w, "internal error", http.StatusInternalServerError)
          return
        }
      
        cfg.logger.Info("paystack charge verified and applied",
          "reference", d.Reference,
          "late", late,
        )
      
        w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
      }
      
      
      func handleRefundEvent(ctx context.Context, w http.ResponseWriter, event PaystackWebhookEvent, processed bool) {
        d := event.Data
      
        transactionRef := d.Reference
        if transactionRef == "" {
          transactionRef = d.Transaction.Reference
        }
        if transactionRef == "" {
          http.Error(w, "missing transaction reference", http.StatusBadRequest)
          return
        }
      
        payment, err := cfg.db.GetPaymentByPaystackReference(ctx, transactionRef)
        if err != nil {
          if errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows) {
            cfg.logger.Warn("refund webhook for unknown reference", "reference", transactionRef)
            w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
            return
          }
          cfg.logger.Error("failed to load payment for refund webhook", "error", err)
          http.Error(w, "internal error", http.StatusInternalServerError)
          return
        }
      
        tx, err := cfg.DB.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
        if err != nil {
          cfg.logger.Error("failed to begin refund webhook transaction", "error", err)
          http.Error(w, "internal error", http.StatusInternalServerError)
          return
        }
        defer rollbackTx(tx)
      
        q := database.New(tx)
      
        dedupKey := webhookDedupKey(event)
        if _, err := q.RecordProcessedWebhookEvent(ctx, dedupKey); err != nil {
          if !errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows) {
            cfg.logger.Error("failed to record webhook event", "error", err)
            http.Error(w, "internal error", http.StatusInternalServerError)
            return
          }
          rollbackTx(tx)
          w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
          return
        }
      
        refund, err := selectRefundForWebhook(ctx, q, payment, d)
        if err != nil {
          cfg.logger.Error("failed to resolve refund for webhook", "reference", transactionRef, "error", err)
          http.Error(w, "internal error", http.StatusInternalServerError)
          return
        }
        if refund == nil {
          rollbackTx(tx)
          w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
          return
        }
      
        if processed {
          if err := applyRefundProcessed(ctx, q, payment, refund, d.ID); err != nil {
            cfg.logger.Error("failed to apply refund.processed", "refundId", refund.ID, "error", err)
            http.Error(w, "internal error", http.StatusInternalServerError)
            return
          }
        } else {
          if err := applyRefundFailed(ctx, q, refund, payment); err != nil {
            cfg.logger.Error("failed to apply refund.failed", "refundId", refund.ID, "error", err)
            http.Error(w, "internal error", http.StatusInternalServerError)
            return
          }
        }
      
        if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
          cfg.logger.Error("failed to commit refund webhook transaction", "error", err)
          http.Error(w, "internal error", http.StatusInternalServerError)
          return
        }
      
        w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
      }
      
      
      func selectRefundForWebhook(
        ctx context.Context,
        q *database.Queries,
        payment database.Payment,
        data struct {
          ID        int64           `json:"id"`
          Status    string          `json:"status"`
          Reference string          `json:"reference"`
          Amount    int64           `json:"amount"`
          Currency  string          `json:"currency"`
          Channel   string          `json:"channel"`
          Transaction struct {
            Reference string `json:"reference"`
            Amount    int64  `json:"amount"`
          } `json:"transaction"`
        },
      ) (*database.Refund, error) {
        if data.ID > 0 {
          rows, err := q.ListActiveRefundsByPaymentId(ctx, payment.ID)
          if err != nil {
            return nil, err
          }
          for i := range rows {
            if rows[i].PaystackRefundID.Valid && rows[i].PaystackRefundID.Int64 == data.ID {
              return &rows[i], nil
            }
          }
        }
      
        rows, err := q.ListActiveRefundsByPaymentId(ctx, payment.ID)
        if err != nil {
          return nil, err
        }
      
        var pending []*database.Refund
        for i := range rows {
          if rows[i].Status == "pending" {
            if data.Amount > 0 && rows[i].Amount != data.Amount {
              continue
            }
            pending = append(pending, &rows[i])
          }
        }
      
        if len(pending) == 0 {
          return nil, nil
        }
      
        return pending[0], nil
      }
      
      
      func webhookDedupKey(event PaystackWebhookEvent) string {
        if event.Data.ID != 0 {
          return event.Event + ":" + strconv.FormatInt(event.Data.ID, 10)
        }
        return event.Event + ":" + event.Data.Reference
      }
      
      func markPaymentSucceededTx(
        ctx context.Context,
        q *database.Queries,
        payment database.Payment,
        channel string,
        late bool,
      ) (bool, error) {
        if payment.Status == "succeeded" ||
          payment.Status == "partially_refunded" ||
          payment.Status == "refunded" {
          return false, nil
        }
      
        if err := q.SetPaymentSucceeded(ctx, database.SetPaymentSucceededParams{
          ID:      payment.ID,
          Channel: sqlNullString(channel),
          Late:    late,
        }); err != nil {
          return false, fmt.Errorf("mark payment succeeded: %w", err)
        }
      
        payment.Status = "succeeded"
        payment.Channel = sqlNullString(channel)
        payment.Late = late
      
        if err := enqueuePaymentCallbackTx(ctx, q, payment, callbackPaymentSucceeded, "succeeded", late); err != nil {
          return false, err
        }
      
        return true, nil
      }
      
      func applyRefundProcessed(
        ctx context.Context,
        q *database.Queries,
        payment database.Payment,
        refund *database.Refund,
        paystackRefundID int64,
      ) error {
        if _, err := q.MarkRefundProcessed(ctx, database.MarkRefundProcessedParams{
          Column1: paystackRefundID,
          ID:               refund.ID,
        }); err != nil {
          return fmt.Errorf("mark refund processed: %w", err)
        }
      
        totalProcessed, err := int64FromAny(q.SumProcessedRefunds(ctx, payment.ID))
        if err != nil {
          return fmt.Errorf("sum processed refunds: %w", err)
        }
      
        newStatus := "partially_refunded"
        if totalProcessed >= payment.Amount {
          newStatus = "refunded"
        }
      
        if err := q.UpdatePaymentRefundStatus(ctx, database.UpdatePaymentRefundStatusParams{
          Amount: totalProcessed,
          ID:     payment.ID,
        }); err != nil {
          return fmt.Errorf("update payment refund status: %w", err)
        }
        payment.Status = newStatus
      
        return enqueuePaymentCallbackTx(ctx, q, payment, callbackPaymentRefunded, newStatus, payment.Late)
      }
      
      func applyRefundFailed(
        ctx context.Context,
        q *database.Queries,
        refund *database.Refund,
        payment database.Payment,
      ) error {
        if _, err := q.MarkRefundFailed(ctx, refund.ID); err != nil {
          return fmt.Errorf("mark refund failed: %w", err)
        }
      
        return enqueuePaymentCallbackTx(ctx, q, payment, callbackPaymentRefundFailed, payment.Status, payment.Late)
      }

      package payments
      
      import (
        "context"
        "database/sql"
        "encoding/json"
        "errors"
        "fmt"
        "time"
      
        "github.com/BUCC-Backend-Team/payment_service_4/internal/database"
        "github.com/google/uuid"
      )
      
      const maxRefundCreateAttempts = 5
      
      type CreateRefundRequest struct {
        IdempotencyKey string
        Amount         int64
      }
      
      type CreateRefundResponse struct {
        RefundID string `json:"refundId"`
        Amount   int64  `json:"amount"`
        Status   string `json:"status"`
        Replayed bool   `json:"-"`
      }
      
      func createRefund(ctx context.Context, paymentID uuid.UUID, req CreateRefundRequest) (CreateRefundResponse, error) {
        if cfg == nil || cfg.db == nil || cfg.DB == nil {
          return CreateRefundResponse{}, errors.New("payment service is not initialized")
        }
      
        if req.IdempotencyKey == "" {
          return CreateRefundResponse{}, errors.New("idempotency key not provided")
        }
        if req.Amount < 0 {
          return CreateRefundResponse{}, errors.New("amount must be a positive integer in kobo")
        }
      
        key := refundIdempotencyPrefix + req.IdempotencyKey
        requestHash := idempotencyRequestHash(fmt.Sprintf("%d", req.Amount))
      
        ownsIt, existing, err := reserveIdempotencyKey(ctx, key, requestHash)
        if err != nil {
          return CreateRefundResponse{}, fmt.Errorf("reserve idempotency key: %w", err)
        }
      
        if !ownsIt {
          if existing.RequestHash != requestHash {
            return CreateRefundResponse{}, newAPIError(422, "idempotency key was already used with a different request body")
          }
      
          if existing.ResponseBody != "" {
            var stored CreateRefundResponse
            if err := decodeIdempotencyResponse(existing.ResponseBody, &stored); err != nil {
              return CreateRefundResponse{}, fmt.Errorf("decode stored idempotency response: %w", err)
            }
            stored.Replayed = true
            return stored, nil
          }
      
          found, pollErr := pollIdempotencyResponse(ctx, key, 10*time.Second)
          if pollErr != nil {
            return CreateRefundResponse{}, fmt.Errorf("wait for concurrent request: %w", pollErr)
          }
          if found {
            var stored CreateRefundResponse
            if err := idempotencyStoredResponse(ctx, key, &stored); err != nil {
              return CreateRefundResponse{}, fmt.Errorf("decode stored idempotency response: %w", err)
            }
            stored.Replayed = true
            return stored, nil
          }
      
        }
      
        tx, err := cfg.DB.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
        if err != nil {
          releaseIdempotencyKey(ctx, key)
          return CreateRefundResponse{}, fmt.Errorf("begin refund transaction: %w", err)
        }
        defer rollbackTx(tx)
      
        q := database.New(tx)
      
        payment, err := q.SelectPaymentByIdForUpdate(ctx, paymentID)
        if err != nil {
          defer releaseIdempotencyKey(ctx, key)
          if errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows) {
            return CreateRefundResponse{}, newAPIError(404, "payment not found")
          }
          return CreateRefundResponse{}, fmt.Errorf("lock payment for refund: %w", err)
        }
      
      
        if payment.Status != "succeeded" &&
          payment.Status != "partially_refunded" &&
          payment.Status != "refunded" {
          defer releaseIdempotencyKey(ctx, key)
          return CreateRefundResponse{}, newAPIError(409, "not_refundable")
        }
      
        authRes, err := int64FromAny(q.SumActiveRefunds(ctx, payment.ID))
        if err != nil {
          defer releaseIdempotencyKey(ctx, key)
          return CreateRefundResponse{}, fmt.Errorf("sum active refunds: %w", err)
        }
      
        // A refunded payment can still be topped back up only if Paystack never
        // processed more than the paid amount, which cannot happen: nothing
        // left.
        refundable := payment.Amount - authRes
        if refundable <= 0 {
          defer releaseIdempotencyKey(ctx, key)
          return CreateRefundResponse{}, newAPIError(409, "not_refundable")
        }
      
        amount := req.Amount
        if amount == 0 {
          amount = refundable
        }
      
        if amount <= 0 || amount > refundable {
          defer releaseIdempotencyKey(ctx, key)
          return CreateRefundResponse{}, newAPIError(409, "not_refundable")
        }
      
        refundID := uuid.New()
        if _, err := q.CreateRefund(ctx, database.CreateRefundParams{
          ID:             refundID,
          PaymentID:      payment.ID,
          IdempotencyKey: req.IdempotencyKey,
          Amount:         amount,
        }); err != nil {
          defer releaseIdempotencyKey(ctx, key)
          return CreateRefundResponse{}, fmt.Errorf("create refund: %w", err)
        }
      
        resp := CreateRefundResponse{
          RefundID: refundID.String(),
          Amount:   amount,
          Status:   "pending",
        }
      
        raw, err := json.Marshal(resp)
        if err != nil {
          defer releaseIdempotencyKey(ctx, key)
          return CreateRefundResponse{}, fmt.Errorf("encode refund response: %w", err)
        }
      
        if err := storeIdempotencyResponse(ctx, q, key, 202, raw); err != nil {
          defer releaseIdempotencyKey(ctx, key)
          return CreateRefundResponse{}, fmt.Errorf("store idempotency response: %w", err)
        }
      
        if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
          defer releaseIdempotencyKey(ctx, key)
          return CreateRefundResponse{}, fmt.Errorf("commit refund transaction: %w", err)
        }
      
        reference := payment.PaystackReference
        go submitRefundToPaystack(context.WithoutCancel(ctx), refundID, reference, amount)
      
        return resp, nil
      }
      
      
      func submitRefundToPaystack(ctx context.Context, refundID uuid.UUID, reference string, amount int64) {
        log := cfg.logger
        if log == nil {
          log = discardLogger()
        }
      
        delay := time.Second
        for attempt := 0; attempt < maxRefundCreateAttempts; attempt++ {
          if ctx.Err() != nil {
            return
          }
          if attempt > 0 {
            select {
            case <-ctx.Done():
              return
            case <-time.After(delay):
            }
            delay *= 2
          }
      
          parsed, outcome, err := createRefundAtPaystack(
            ctx,
            reference,
            amount,
          )
          if err == nil {
            if parsed.Data.ID > 0 {
              _ = cfg.db.SetRefundPaystackId(ctx, database.SetRefundPaystackIdParams{
                ID:               refundID,
                PaystackRefundID: sql.NullInt64{Int64: parsed.Data.ID, Valid: true},
              })
            }
            return
          }
      
          switch outcome {
          case refundErrRetryable, refundErrAmbiguous:
            continue
          case refundErrUnrecoverable:
            if err := refundFailedTx(ctx, refundID); err != nil {
              log.Error("failed to mark refund failed", "refundId", refundID, "error", err)
            }
            return
          }
        }
      
        log.Error("refund still unresolved after retries; leaving pending for reconciliation",
          "refundId", refundID,
        )
      }

      package payments
      
      import (
        "context"
        "crypto/sha256"
        "database/sql"
        "encoding/hex"
        "errors"
        "fmt"
        "strings"
        "time"
      
        "github.com/BUCC-Backend-Team/payment_service_4/internal/database"
      )
      
      const (
        paymentIdempotencyPrefix = "p:"
        refundIdempotencyPrefix  = "r:"
      )
      
      type apiError struct {
        Status int
        Code   string
      }
      
      func (e apiError) Error() string { return e.Code }
      
      func newAPIError(status int, code string) error {
        return apiError{Status: status, Code: code}
      }
      
      func idempotencyRequestHash(fields ...string) string {
        normalized := make([]string, len(fields))
        for i, f := range fields {
          normalized[i] = strings.TrimSpace(f)
        }
        sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(strings.Join(normalized, "\x1f")))
        return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
      }
      
      func reserveIdempotencyKey(
        ctx context.Context,
        key string,
        requestHash string,
      ) (bool, database.IdempotencyKey, error) {
        _, err := cfg.db.ReserveIdempotencyKey(ctx, database.ReserveIdempotencyKeyParams{
          Key:         key,
          RequestHash: requestHash,
        })
      
        if err == nil {
          return true, database.IdempotencyKey{}, nil
        }
      
        if !errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows) {
          return false, database.IdempotencyKey{}, err
        }
      
        // Lost the race: the key already exists.
        existing, err := cfg.db.GetIdempotencyKey(ctx, key)
        if err != nil {
          if errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows) {
            return reserveIdempotencyKey(ctx, key, requestHash)
          }
          return false, database.IdempotencyKey{}, err
        }
      
        return false, existing, nil
      }
      
      func idempotencyStoredResponse(ctx context.Context, key string, into any) error {
        row, err := cfg.db.GetIdempotencyKey(ctx, key)
        if err != nil {
          return err
        }
        if row.ResponseBody == "" {
          return sql.ErrNoRows
        }
        return decodeIdempotencyResponse(row.ResponseBody, into)
      }
      
      func decodeIdempotencyResponse(raw string, into any) error {
        return jsonUnmarshal([]byte(raw), into)
      }
      
      func pollIdempotencyResponse(ctx context.Context, key string, timeout time.Duration) (bool, error) {
        deadline := time.Now().Add(timeout)
        delay := 20 * time.Millisecond
      
        for time.Now().Before(deadline) {
          select {
          case <-ctx.Done():
            return false, ctx.Err()
          case <-time.After(delay):
          }
      
          row, err := cfg.db.GetIdempotencyKey(ctx, key)
          if err == nil && row.ResponseBody != "" {
            return true, nil
          }
      
          if delay < 500*time.Millisecond {
            delay *= 2
          }
        }
      
        return false, nil
      }
      
      func storeIdempotencyResponse(ctx context.Context, q *database.Queries, key string, status int32, body []byte) error {
        return q.UpdateIdempotencyResponse(ctx, database.UpdateIdempotencyResponseParams{
          Key:            key,
          ResponseBody:   string(body),
          ResponseStatus: sqlNullInt32FromInt(status),
        })
      }
      
      func releaseIdempotencyKey(ctx context.Context, key string) {
        if err := cfg.db.DeleteIdempotencyKey(ctx, key); err != nil {
          if cfg.logger != nil {
            cfg.logger.Error("failed to release idempotency key", "key", key, "error", err)
          }
        }
      }
      
      func classifyCreatePaymentConflict(err error) error {
        msg := err.Error()
        if strings.Contains(msg, "payments_one_active_per_order") {
          return newAPIError(409, "payment_exists")
        }
        if strings.Contains(msg, "unique constraint") || strings.Contains(msg, "duplicate key") {
          return newAPIError(409, "payment_exists")
        }
        return fmt.Errorf("create payment: %w", err)
      }

- path: internal/payments/expiry_worker.go
  content: |
      package payments
      
      import (
        "context"
        "database/sql"
        "time"
      
        "github.com/BUCC-Backend-Team/payment_service_4/internal/database"
      )
      
      
      func StartPaymentExpiryWorker(ctx context.Context, interval time.Duration) {
        if cfg == nil || cfg.db == nil {
          return
        }
        if interval <= 0 {
          interval = defaultWorkerInterval
        }
      
        cfg.logger.Info("expiry and reconciliation worker started", "interval", interval)
      
        run := func() {
          reconcilePayments(ctx)
          reconcileRefunds(ctx)
        }
      
        // Process overdue payments immediately on startup.
        run()
      
        ticker := time.NewTicker(interval)
        defer ticker.Stop()
      
        for {
          select {
          case <-ctx.Done():
            return
          case <-ticker.C:
            run()
          }
        }
      }
      
      func reconcilePayments(ctx context.Context) {
        log := cfg.logger
        if log == nil {
          log = discardLogger()
        }
      
        rows, err := cfg.db.ListPendingPayments(ctx)
        if err != nil {
          log.Error("failed to list pending payments", "error", err)
          return
        }
      
        now := time.Now()
        for _, payment := range rows {
          if ctx.Err() != nil {
            return
          }
      
          vt, err := verifyTransaction(ctx, payment.PaystackReference)
          if err != nil {
            log.Warn("reconciliation verify failed", "reference", payment.PaystackReference, "error", err)
            continue
          }
      
          if vt.Data.Status == "success" &&
            vt.Data.Amount == payment.Amount &&
            vt.Data.Currency == payment.Currency {
            if _, err := markPaymentSucceededByReference(
              ctx,
              payment.PaystackReference,
              vt.Data.Channel,
              false,
            ); err != nil {
              log.Error("reconciliation failed to mark payment succeeded",
                "reference", payment.PaystackReference, "error", err)
            }
            continue
          }
      
          if !payment.ExpiresAt.Valid || payment.ExpiresAt.Time.After(now) {
            continue
          }
      
          expired, err := markPaymentExpiredAndNotify(ctx, payment.ID)
          if err != nil {
            log.Error("failed to expire payment",
              "reference", payment.PaystackReference, "error", err)
          } else if expired {
            log.Info("expired overdue payment", "reference", payment.PaystackReference)
          }
        }
      }
      
      func reconcileRefunds(ctx context.Context) {
        log := cfg.logger
        if log == nil {
          log = discardLogger()
        }
      
        rows, err := cfg.db.ListPendingRefundsForReconcile(ctx, float64(refundReconcileGraceSeconds))
        if err != nil {
          log.Error("failed to list pending refunds", "error", err)
          return
        }
      
        for _, refund := range rows {
          if ctx.Err() != nil {
            return
          }
      
          payment, err := cfg.db.SelectPaymentByIdForUpdate(ctx, refund.PaymentID)
          if err != nil {
            log.Warn("pending refund references a missing payment", "refundId", refund.ID, "error", err)
            continue
          }
      
          parsed, outcome, createErr := createRefundAtPaystack(
            ctx,
            payment.PaystackReference,
            refund.Amount,
          )
      
          switch {
          case createErr == nil:
            if parsed.Data.ID > 0 {
              _ = cfg.db.SetRefundPaystackId(ctx, database.SetRefundPaystackIdParams{
                ID:               refund.ID,
                PaystackRefundID: sql.NullInt64{Int64: parsed.Data.ID, Valid: true},
              })
            }
          case outcome == refundErrUnrecoverable:
            if err := refundFailedTx(ctx, refund.ID); err != nil {
              log.Error("reconciliation failed to mark refund failed",
                "refundId", refund.ID, "error", err)
            }
          default:
            log.Warn("reconciliation refund attempt failed; stays pending",
              "refundId", refund.ID, "error", createErr)
          }
        }
      }
      
      const refundReconcileGraceSeconds = 30

- path: internal/payments/charge_authorization.go
  content: |
      
      package payments
      
      import (
        "context"
        "encoding/json"
        "errors"
        "fmt"
        "strings"
      )
      
      const caURL = "https://api.paystack.co/transaction/initialize"
      
      var sendRequest = SendRequest
      
      type caBody struct {
        Amount   int64  `json:"amount"`
        Email    string `json:"email"`
        Reference string `json:"reference"`
        Currency string `json:"currency"`
      }
      
      type caData struct {
        AuthorizationUrl string `json:"authorization_url"`
        AccessCode       string `json:"access_code"`
        Reference        string `json:"reference"`
      }
      
      type caResponse struct {
        Status  bool   `json:"status"`
        Message string `json:"message"`
        Data    caData `json:"data"`
      }
      
      func chargeAuthorization(ctx context.Context, amount int64, email string, reference string) (caResponse, error) {
        if cfg == nil {
          return caResponse{}, errors.New("payment service is not initialized")
        }
      
        if strings.TrimSpace(cfg.paystackSecretKey) == "" {
          return caResponse{}, errors.New("Paystack secret key is not configured")
        }
      
        body := caBody{
          Amount:    amount,
          Email:     email,
          Reference: reference,
          Currency:  "NGN",
        }
      
        data, err := json.Marshal(body)
        if err != nil {
          if cfg.logger != nil {
            cfg.logger.Error("failed to encode Paystack request body", "err", err)
          }
          return caResponse{}, fmt.Errorf("encode Paystack request: %w", err)
        }
      
        headers := map[string]string{
          "Authorization": fmt.Sprintf("Bearer %s", cfg.paystackSecretKey),
          "Content-Type":  "application/json",
          "Accept":        "application/json",
        }
      
        res, err := sendRequest(ctx, caURL, "POST", data, headers)
        if err != nil {
          if cfg.logger != nil {
            cfg.logger.Error("failed to initialize Paystack transaction", "err", err)
          }
          return caResponse{}, fmt.Errorf("send Paystack request: %w", err)
        }
      
        var resBody caResponse
        if err := json.Unmarshal(res.Body, &resBody); err != nil {
          if cfg.logger != nil {
            cfg.logger.Error("failed to decode Paystack response", "err", err)
          }
          return caResponse{}, fmt.Errorf("decode Paystack response: %w", err)
        }
      
        if !resBody.Status {
          return caResponse{}, fmt.Errorf("Paystack initialization failed: %s", resBody.Message)
        }
      
        if strings.TrimSpace(resBody.Data.AuthorizationUrl) == "" {
          return caResponse{}, errors.New("Paystack returned an empty authorization URL")
        }
      
        if resBody.Data.Reference != reference {
          return caResponse{}, errors.New("Paystack returned a mismatched transaction reference")
        }
      
        return resBody, nil
      }

- path: internal/payments/auth.go
  content: |
      
      package payments
      
      import (
        "crypto/subtle"
        "net/http"
        "strings"
      )
      
      func authenticateMerchant(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) bool {
        expectedKey := cfg.merchantApiKey
      
        if expectedKey == "" {
          writeJSON(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, map[string]string{
            "error": "merchant authentication is not configured",
          })
          return false
        }
      
        parts := strings.Fields(r.Header.Get("Authorization"))
      
        if len(parts) != 2 || !strings.EqualFold(parts[0], "Bearer") {
          writeJSON(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, map[string]string{
            "error": "missing or invalid merchant authorization",
          })
          return false
        }
      
        providedKey := parts[1]
      
        if subtle.ConstantTimeCompare([]byte(providedKey), []byte(expectedKey)) != 1 {
          writeJSON(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, map[string]string{
            "error": "invalid merchant API key",
          })
          return false
        }
      
        return true
      }

      package payments
      
      import (
        "database/sql"
        "encoding/json"
        "fmt"
        "errors"
        "io"
        "log/slog"
        "strings"
      
        "github.com/lib/pq"
      )
      
      func discardLogger() *slog.Logger {
        return slog.New(slog.NewTextHandler(io.Discard, nil))
      }
      
      func rollbackTx(tx *sql.Tx) {
        if tx != nil {
          _ = tx.Rollback()
        }
      }
      
      func isUniqueViolation(err error) bool {
        var pqErr *pq.Error
        if errors.As(err, &pqErr) {
          return pqErr.Code == "23505"
        }
        msg := strings.ToLower(err.Error())
        return strings.Contains(msg, "duplicate key") || strings.Contains(msg, "unique constraint")
      }
      
      func sqlNullInt32FromInt(v int32) sql.NullInt32 {
        return sql.NullInt32{Int32: v, Valid: true}
      }
      
      func int64FromAny(v interface{}, err error) (int64, error) {
        if err != nil {
          return 0, err
        }
        switch x := v.(type) {
        case int64:
          return x, nil
        case int32:
          return int64(x), nil
        case int:
          return int64(x), nil
        case string:
          var parsed int64
          if _, scanErr := fmt.Sscanf(x, "%d", &parsed); scanErr != nil {
            return 0, scanErr
          }
          return parsed, nil
        case nil:
          return 0, nil
        default:
          return 0, fmt.Errorf("unexpected SUM type %T", x)
        }
      }
      
      func jsonUnmarshal(raw []byte, into any) error {
        return json.Unmarshal(raw, into)
      }

          return nil, fmt.Errorf("lock payment for succeeded: %w", err)
        }
      
        if payment.Status == "succeeded" ||
          payment.Status == "partially_refunded" ||
          payment.Status == "refunded" {
          p := payment
          return &p, nil
        }
      
        if err := q.SetPaymentSucceeded(ctx, database.SetPaymentSucceededParams{
          ID:      payment.ID,
          Channel: sqlNullString(channel),
          Late:    late,
        }); err != nil {
          return nil, fmt.Errorf("mark payment succeeded: %w", err)
        }
      
        payment.Status = "succeeded"
        payment.Channel = sqlNullString(channel)
        payment.Late = late
      
        if err := enqueuePaymentCallbackTx(ctx, q, payment, callbackPaymentSucceeded, "succeeded", late); err != nil {
          return nil, fmt.Errorf("enqueue succeeded callback: %w", err)
        }
      
        if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
          return nil, fmt.Errorf("commit succeeded transaction: %w", err)
        }
      
        return &payment, nil
      }
      
      func markPaymentExpiredAndNotify(ctx context.Context, id uuid.UUID) (bool, error) {
        tx, err := cfg.DB.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
        if err != nil {
          return false, fmt.Errorf("begin expired transaction: %w", err)
        }
        defer rollbackTx(tx)
      
        q := database.New(tx)
      
        payment, err := q.SelectPaymentByIdForUpdate(ctx, id)
        if err != nil {
          if errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows) {
            return false, nil
          }
          return false, fmt.Errorf("lock payment for expired: %w", err)
        }
      
        if payment.Status != "pending" {
          return false, tx.Rollback()
        }
      
        if err := q.MarkPaymentExpired(ctx, id); err != nil {
          return false, fmt.Errorf("mark payment expired: %w", err)
        }
        payment.Status = "expired"
      
        if err := enqueuePaymentCallbackTx(ctx, q, payment, callbackPaymentExpired, "expired", false); err != nil {
          return false, fmt.Errorf("enqueue expired callback: %w", err)
        }
      
        if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
          return false, fmt.Errorf("commit expired transaction: %w", err)
        }
      
        return true, nil
      }
      
      
      func refundFailedTx(ctx context.Context, refundID uuid.UUID) error {
        tx, err := cfg.DB.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
        if err != nil {
          return fmt.Errorf("begin refund failed transaction: %w", err)
        }
        defer rollbackTx(tx)
      
        q := database.New(tx)
      
        refund, err := q.MarkRefundFailed(ctx, refundID)
        if err != nil {
          if errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows) {
            return tx.Rollback()
          }
          return fmt.Errorf("mark refund failed: %w", err)
        }
      
        payment, err := q.SelectPaymentByIdForUpdate(ctx, refund.PaymentID)
        if err != nil {
          return fmt.Errorf("lock payment for refund failure: %w", err)
        }
      
        if err := enqueuePaymentCallbackTx(ctx, q, payment, callbackPaymentRefundFailed, payment.Status, payment.Late); err != nil {
          return fmt.Errorf("enqueue refund failed callback: %w", err)
        }
      
        return tx.Commit()
      }

- path: internal/payments/refund_client.go
  content: |
      package payments
      
      import (
        "context"
        "encoding/json"
        "fmt"
        "strings"
      )
      
      const refundURL = "https://api.paystack.co/refund"
      
      type refundRequestBody struct {
        Transaction string `json:"transaction"`
        Amount      int64  `json:"amount,omitempty"`
      }
      
      type refundResponse struct {
        Status  bool   `json:"status"`
        Message string `json:"message"`
        Data    struct {
          ID       int64  `json:"id"`
          Status   string `json:"status"`
          Amount   int64  `json:"amount"`
          Currency string `json:"currency"`
        } `json:"data"`
      }
      
      type refundErrOutcome int
      
      const (
        refundErrRetryable refundErrOutcome = iota
        refundErrUnrecoverable
        refundErrAmbiguous
      )
      
      func createRefundAtPaystack(
        ctx context.Context,
        reference string,
        amount int64,
      ) (refundResponse, refundErrOutcome, error) {
        if cfg == nil {
          return refundResponse{}, refundErrAmbiguous, fmt.Errorf("payment service is not initialized")
        }
      
        body, err := json.Marshal(refundRequestBody{
          Transaction: reference,
          Amount:      amount,
        })
        if err != nil {
          return refundResponse{}, refundErrAmbiguous, fmt.Errorf("encode refund request: %w", err)
        }
      
        headers := map[string]string{
          "Authorization": "Bearer " + cfg.paystackSecretKey,
          "Content-Type":  "application/json",
        }
      
        res, err := sendRequest(ctx, refundURL, "POST", body, headers)
        if err != nil {
          if cfg.logger != nil {
            cfg.logger.Error("refund request to Paystack failed", "error", err)
          }
          return refundResponse{}, refundErrAmbiguous, fmt.Errorf("send refund request: %w", err)
        }
      
        var parsed refundResponse
        if err := json.Unmarshal(res.Body, &parsed); err != nil {
          return refundResponse{}, refundErrAmbiguous, fmt.Errorf("decode refund response: %w", err)
        }
      
        if res.StatusCode >= 200 && res.StatusCode <= 299 && parsed.Status {
          return parsed, refundErrRetryable, nil
        }
      
        if res.StatusCode >= 500 {
          if cfg.logger != nil {
            cfg.logger.Warn("Paystack 5xx on refund", "status", res.StatusCode, "message", parsed.Message)
          }
          return parsed, refundErrAmbiguous, fmt.Errorf("paystack 5xx on refund")
        }
      
        limit := strings.ToLower(parsed.Message)
        if strings.Contains(limit, "already") || strings.Contains(limit, "in progress") {
          return parsed, refundErrAmbiguous, nil
        }
      
        return parsed, refundErrUnrecoverable, fmt.Errorf("paystack refund rejected: %s", parsed.Message)
      }

      type config struct {

        expiresIn         time.Duration
      
        callbackURL      string

        workerInterval   time.Duration
        callbackInterval time.Duration
      }
      
      var cfg *config
      
      const (
        defaultPaymentTimeout   = 30 * time.Minute
        defaultWorkerInterval   = 30 * time.Second
        defaultCallbackInterval = time.Second
      )
      
      func New(
        paystackSecretKey string,
        logger *slog.Logger,
        db *database.Queries,
        DB *sql.DB,
        merchantApiKey string,
        expiresIn time.Duration,
        callbackURL string,
        callbackSecret string,
        testMode bool,
        workerInterval time.Duration,
        callbackInterval time.Duration,
      ) {
        if expiresIn <= 0 {
          expiresIn = defaultPaymentTimeout
        }
        if workerInterval <= 0 {
          workerInterval = defaultWorkerInterval
        }
        if callbackInterval <= 0 {
          callbackInterval = defaultCallbackInterval
        }
      
        cfg = &config{
          paystackSecretKey: paystackSecretKey,
          logger:            logger,
          db:                db,
          DB:                DB,
          merchantApiKey:    merchantApiKey,
          expiresIn:         expiresIn,
          callbackURL:       callbackURL,
          callbackSecret:    callbackSecret,
          testMode:          testMode,
          workerInterval:    workerInterval,
          callbackInterval:  callbackInterval,
        }
      }

- path: internal/payments/verify_transaction.go
  content: |
      package payments
      
      import (
        "context"
        "encoding/json"
        "fmt"
      )
      
      type PaystackVerificationResponse struct {
        Status  bool                    `json:"status"`
        Message string                  `json:"message"`
        Data    PaystackTransactionData `json:"data"`
      }
      
      type PaystackTransactionData struct {
        ID          int64                 `json:"id"`
        Status      string                `json:"status"`
        Reference   string                `json:"reference"`
        Amount      int64                 `json:"amount"`
        PaidAt      string                `json:"paid_at"`
        CreatedAt   string                `json:"created_at"`
        Channel     string                `json:"channel"`
        Currency    string                `json:"currency"`
        Authorization PaystackAuthorization `json:"authorization"`
        Customer    PaystackCustomer      `json:"customer"`
        TransactionDate string            `json:"transaction_date"`
      }
      
      type PaystackAuthorization struct {
        AuthorizationCode string  `json:"authorization_code"`
        CardType          string  `json:"card_type"`
        Bank              string  `json:"bank"`
        CountryCode       string  `json:"country_code"`
        Signature         string  `json:"signature"`
      }
      
      type PaystackCustomer struct {
        ID           int64  `json:"id"`
        Email        string `json:"email"`
        CustomerCode string `json:"customer_code"`
      }
      
      const vtURL = "https://api.paystack.co/transaction/verify/%s"
      
      func verifyTransaction(ctx context.Context, reference string) (PaystackVerificationResponse, error) {
        url := fmt.Sprintf(vtURL, reference)
      
        headers := map[string]string{
          "Authorization": "Bearer " + cfg.paystackSecretKey,
        }
      
        res, err := sendRequest(ctx, url, "GET", nil, headers)
        if err != nil {
          if cfg.logger != nil {
            cfg.logger.Error("failed to verify transaction", "err", err)
          }
          return PaystackVerificationResponse{}, err
        }
      
        var vtRes PaystackVerificationResponse
        if err := json.Unmarshal(res.Body, &vtRes); err != nil {
          if cfg.logger != nil {
            cfg.logger.Error("failed to decode response", "err", err)
          }
          return PaystackVerificationResponse{}, err
        }
      
        if res.StatusCode < 200 || res.StatusCode > 299 || !vtRes.Status {
          return PaystackVerificationResponse{}, fmt.Errorf(
            "transaction verify failed (http %d): %s",
            res.StatusCode,
            vtRes.Message,
          )
        }
      
        return vtRes, nil
      }

- path: internal/payments/utils.go
  content: |
      package payments
      
      import (
        "bytes"
        "context"
        "io"
        "net/http"
        "time"
      )
      
      type Response struct {
        StatusCode int
        Body       []byte
        Headers    http.Header
      }
      
      func SendRequest(ctx context.Context, url string, method string, body []byte, headers map[string]string) (*Response, error) {
        client := &http.Client{
          Timeout: 30 * time.Second,
        }
      
        req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(
          ctx,
          method,
          url,
          bytes.NewReader(body),
        )
        if err != nil {
          return nil, err
        }
      
        for key, value := range headers {
          req.Header.Set(key, value)
        }
      
        resp, err := client.Do(req)
        if err != nil {
          return nil, err
        }
        defer resp.Body.Close()
      
        respBody, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
        if err != nil {
          return nil, err
        }
      
        return &Response{
          StatusCode: resp.StatusCode,
          Body:       respBody,
          Headers:    resp.Header.Clone(),
        }, nil
      }

- path: utils.go
  content: |
      package main
      
      import (
        "context"
        "database/sql"
        "errors"
        "fmt"
        "log/slog"
        "net/http"
        "os"
        "os/signal"
        "strconv"
        "strings"
        "syscall"
        "time"
      
        "github.com/spf13/viper"
        "github.com/BUCC-Backend-Team/payment_service_4/internal/database"
        "github.com/BUCC-Backend-Team/payment_service_4/internal/payments"
      )
      
      type config struct {
        logger *slog.Logger
        db *database.Queries
        DB *sql.DB
        paymentTimeoutSeconds        time.Duration
        paymentExpiryWorkerInterval  time.Duration
        callbackWorkerInterval       time.Duration
      }
      
      var cfg *config
      
      var logger = initializeLogger()
      
      func LoadEnv() error {
        viper.SetConfigFile(".env")
        viper.AutomaticEnv()
      
        if err := viper.ReadInConfig(); err != nil {
          return fmt.Errorf("failed to load .env: %w", err)
        }
      
        return nil
      }
      
      func initializeLogger() *slog.Logger {
        return slog.New(slog.NewJSONHandler(os.Stderr, &slog.HandlerOptions{
          Level: slog.LevelInfo,
        }))
      }
      
      func loggerWithLevel(raw string) *slog.Logger {
        level := slog.LevelInfo
        switch strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(raw)) {
        case "debug":
          level = slog.LevelDebug
        case "warn", "warning":
          level = slog.LevelWarn
        case "error":
          level = slog.LevelError
        }
        return slog.New(slog.NewJSONHandler(os.Stderr, &slog.HandlerOptions{Level: level}))
      }
      
      func run () {
        if err := LoadEnv(); err != nil {
          logger.Error(err.Error())
          os.Exit(1)
        }
      
        logger = loggerWithLevel(viper.GetString("LOG_LEVEL"))
        slog.SetDefault(logger)
      
        dbURL := viper.GetString("DATABASE_URL")
        db, err := connectPostgres(dbURL)
        if err != nil {
          logger.Error(err.Error())
          os.Exit(1)
        }
        defer db.Close()
      
        paystackSecretKey := viper.GetString("PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY")
        merchantApiKey := viper.GetString("MERCHANT_API_KEY")
        callbackURL := viper.GetString("CALLBACK_URL")
        callbackSecret := viper.GetString("CALLBACK_SECRET")
        testMode := strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimSpace(viper.GetString("TEST_MODE")), "true")
        paymentTimeoutSeconds, _ := strconv.Atoi(viper.GetString("PAYMENT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS"))
        paymentExpiryWorkerInterval, _ := strconv.Atoi(viper.GetString("PAYMENT_EXPIRY_WORKER_INTERVAL_SECONDS"))
        callbackWorkerInterval, _ := strconv.Atoi(viper.GetString("CALLBACK_WORKER_INTERVAL_SECONDS"))
      
        cfg = &config{
          logger: logger,
          db: database.New(db),
          DB: db,
          paymentTimeoutSeconds: time.Duration(paymentTimeoutSeconds) * time.Second,
          paymentExpiryWorkerInterval: time.Duration(paymentExpiryWorkerInterval) * time.Second,
          callbackWorkerInterval: time.Duration(callbackWorkerInterval) * time.Second,
        }
      
        payments.New(
          paystackSecretKey,
          logger,
          cfg.db,
          db,
          merchantApiKey,
          cfg.paymentTimeoutSeconds,
          callbackURL,
          callbackSecret,
          testMode,
          cfg.paymentExpiryWorkerInterval,
          cfg.callbackWorkerInterval,
        )
      
        workerCtx, cancelWorker := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
        defer cancelWorker()
      
        go payments.StartPaymentExpiryWorker(
          workerCtx,
          cfg.paymentExpiryWorkerInterval,
        )
      
        go payments.StartCallbackDeliveryWorker(
          workerCtx,
          cfg.callbackWorkerInterval,
        )
      
        mux := http.NewServeMux()
        registerRoutes(mux)
      
        addr := fmt.Sprintf("0.0.0.0:%s", viper.GetString("PORT"))
        server := http.Server{
          Addr: addr,
          Handler: mux,
          ReadHeaderTimeout: 30 * time.Second,
        }
      
        shutdownCtx, stop := signal.NotifyContext(
          context.Background(),
          os.Interrupt,
          syscall.SIGTERM,
        )
        defer stop()
      
        go func() {
          logger.Info("payment service starting", "address", addr)
      
          if err := server.ListenAndServe(); err != nil &&
            !errors.Is(err, http.ErrServerClosed) {
              cfg.logger.Error("server error", "error", err)
              os.Exit(1)
            }
        }()
      
        <-shutdownCtx.Done()
      
        cfg.logger.Info("shutdown signal rceived")
      
        ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(
          context.Background(),
          30*time.Second,
        )
        defer cancel()
      
        if err := server.Shutdown(ctx); err != nil {
          cfg.logger.Error("graceful shutdown failed", "error", err)
          os.Exit(1)
        }
        
        cfg.logger.Info("server stopped")
      }

      func TestAuthenticateMerchant(t *testing.T) {
        const validKey = "mkt_test_7f9c2a8d4e6b1f305a7c9d2e8b4f6103"
      
        tests := []struct {
          name           string
          expectedKey    string

        }{

            expectedKey:       validKey,
            authHeader:        "Bearer " + validKey,
            wantAuthenticated: true,
            wantStatus:        http.StatusOK,
          },
          {
            name:              "valid bearer token with lowercase scheme",
            expectedKey:       validKey,
            authHeader:        "bearer " + validKey,
            wantAuthenticated: true,
            wantStatus:        http.StatusOK,
          },
          {
            name:              "missing authorization header",
            expectedKey:       validKey,
            authHeader:        "",
            wantAuthenticated: false,
            wantStatus:        http.StatusUnauthorized,
          },
          {
            name:              "invalid api key",
            expectedKey:       validKey,
            authHeader:        "Bearer wrong-key",
            wantAuthenticated: false,
            wantStatus:        http.StatusUnauthorized,
          },
          {
            name:              "missing bearer scheme",
            expectedKey:       validKey,
            authHeader:        validKey,
            wantAuthenticated: false,
            wantStatus:        http.StatusUnauthorized,
          },
          {
            name:              "incorrect authorization scheme",
            expectedKey:       validKey,
            authHeader:        "Basic " + validKey,
            wantAuthenticated: false,
            wantStatus:        http.StatusUnauthorized,
          },
          {
            name:              "bearer without token",
            expectedKey:       validKey,
            authHeader:        "Bearer",
            wantAuthenticated: false,
            wantStatus:        http.StatusUnauthorized,
          },
          {
            name:              "extra authorization fields",
            expectedKey:       validKey,
            authHeader:        "Bearer " + validKey + " extra",
            wantAuthenticated: false,
            wantStatus:        http.StatusUnauthorized,
          },
          {
            name:              "unconfigured merchant api key",
            expectedKey:       "",
            authHeader:        "Bearer " + validKey,
            wantAuthenticated: false,
            wantStatus:        http.StatusInternalServerError,
          },
        }

          t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
            originalCfg := cfg
      
            t.Cleanup(func() {

            })
