      package payments
      
      import (
        "context"
        "crypto/sha256"
        "database/sql"
        "encoding/hex"
        "encoding/json"
        "errors"
        "fmt"
        "log/slog"
        "net/http"
        "strconv"
        "time"
      
        "github.com/google/uuid"
      
        "github.com/BUCC-Backend-Team/payment_service_4/internal/callbacks"
        "github.com/BUCC-Backend-Team/payment_service_4/src/db"
        apperrors "github.com/BUCC-Backend-Team/payment_service_4/internal/errors"
        "github.com/BUCC-Backend-Team/payment_service_4/internal/providers"
      )
      
      const (
        StatusPending           = "pending"
        StatusSucceeded         = "succeeded"
        StatusExpired           = "expired"
        StatusPartiallyRefunded = "partially_refunded"
        StatusRefunded          = "refunded"
      
        defaultTimeoutSeconds = 1800
        waiterInterval        = 40 * time.Millisecond
      )
      
      type CreateRequest struct {
        OrderID       string
        Amount        int64
        Currency      string
        CustomerEmail string
        ReturnURL     string
      }
      
      type CreateResult struct {
        PaymentID   string `json:"paymentId"`
        OrderID     string `json:"orderId"`
        Status      string `json:"status"`
        Amount      int64  `json:"amount"`
        Currency    string `json:"currency"`
        CheckoutURL string `json:"checkoutUrl"`
      }
      
      type Payment struct {
        ID             uuid.UUID `json:"id"`
        OrderID        string    `json:"orderId"`
        Amount         int64     `json:"amount"`
        Currency       string    `json:"currency"`
        Status         string    `json:"status"`
        Channel        string    `json:"channel"`
        AmountRefunded int64     `json:"amountRefunded"`
        CreatedAt      time.Time `json:"createdAt"`
      }
      
      type Service struct {
        store    *db.Store
        provider providers.Provider
        log      *slog.Logger
        timeout  time.Duration
      }
      
      func NewService(store *db.Store, provider providers.Provider, log *slog.Logger, paymentTimeout time.Duration) *Service {
        if paymentTimeout <= 0 {
          paymentTimeout = defaultTimeoutSeconds * time.Second
        }
        return &Service{
          store:    store,
          provider: provider,
          log:      log,
          timeout:  paymentTimeout,
        }
      }
      
      func (s *Service) Create(ctx context.Context, req CreateRequest, idemKey string) (CreateResult, bool, error) {
        rec, ok, err := s.consumeIdempotency(ctx, req, idemKey)
        if err != nil {
          return CreateResult{}, false, err
        }
        if ok {
          return rec, true, nil
        }
      
        created, err := s.createPayment(ctx, req, idemKey)
        if err != nil {
          return CreateResult{}, false, err
        }
        return created, false, nil
      }
      
      
      func (s *Service) consumeIdempotency(ctx context.Context, req CreateRequest, idemKey string) (CreateResult, bool, error) {
        bodyHash := requestHash(req.OrderID, strconv.FormatInt(req.Amount, 10), req.Currency, req.CustomerEmail, req.ReturnURL)
        key := db.PaymentScope + idemKey
      
        record, err := s.store.GetIdempotencyRecord(ctx, key)
        if err == nil {
          if record.RequestHash != bodyHash {
            return CreateResult{}, false, apperrors.New(http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, "key_reuse_mismatch", "Idempotency-Key reused with a different body")
          }
          if record.ResponseBody != "" {
            var saved CreateResult
            if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(record.ResponseBody), &saved); err != nil {
              return CreateResult{}, false, fmt.Errorf("payments: decode stored response: %w", err)
            }
            return saved, true, nil
          }
        } else if !errors.Is(err, db.ErrNotFound) {
          return CreateResult{}, false, fmt.Errorf("payments: read idempotency record: %w", err)
        }
      
        reserved, err := s.store.ReserveIdempotencyKey(ctx, key, bodyHash)
        if err != nil {
          return CreateResult{}, false, fmt.Errorf("payments: reserve idempotency key: %w", err)
        }
        if reserved {
          return CreateResult{}, false, nil
        }
      
        winner, found, err := s.waitForKey(ctx, key, s.callWait())
        if err != nil {
          return CreateResult{}, false, err
        }
        if found {
          if winner.RequestHash != bodyHash {
            return CreateResult{}, false, apperrors.New(http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, "key_reuse_mismatch", "Idempotency-Key reused with a different body")
          }
          var saved CreateResult
          if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(winner.ResponseBody), &saved); err != nil {
            return CreateResult{}, false, fmt.Errorf("payments: decode stored response: %w", err)
          }
          return saved, true, nil
        }
      
        return CreateResult{}, false, apperrors.New(http.StatusConflict, "idempotency_in_progress", "A request with this Idempotency-Key is still in flight")
      }
      
      func (s *Service) callWait() time.Duration {
        return 10 * time.Second
      }
      
      func (s *Service) waitForKey(ctx context.Context, key string, timeout time.Duration) (db.IdempotencyRecord, bool, error) {
        deadline := time.Now().Add(timeout)
      
        for time.Now().Before(deadline) {
          select {
          case <-ctx.Done():
            return db.IdempotencyRecord{}, false, ctx.Err()
          case <-time.After(waiterInterval):
          }
      
          record, err := s.store.GetIdempotencyRecord(ctx, key)
          if err == nil && record.ResponseBody != "" {
            return record, true, nil
          }
          if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, db.ErrNotFound) {
            return db.IdempotencyRecord{}, false, fmt.Errorf("payments: poll idempotency record: %w", err)
          }
        }
      
        return db.IdempotencyRecord{}, false, nil
      }
      
      
      func (s *Service) createPayment(ctx context.Context, req CreateRequest, idemKey string) (CreateResult, error) {
        paymentID := uuid.New()
      
        created, err := s.store.CreatePayment(ctx, db.Payment{
          ID:            paymentID,
          OrderID:       req.OrderID,
          Amount:        req.Amount,
          Currency:      req.Currency,
          CustomerEmail: req.CustomerEmail,
          ReturnURL:     req.ReturnURL,
          Status:        StatusPending,
          Reference:     paymentID.String(),
          ExpiresAt:     sql.NullTime{Time: time.Now().UTC().Add(s.timeout), Valid: true},
        })
        if err != nil {
          if errors.Is(err, db.ErrUnique) {
            _ = s.store.DeleteIdempotencyKey(ctx, db.PaymentScope+idemKey)
            return CreateResult{}, apperrors.New(http.StatusConflict, "payment_exists", "A payment already exists for this order")
          }
          return CreateResult{}, fmt.Errorf("payments: create payment: %w", err)
        }
      
        return s.initialize(ctx, created, idemKey)
      }
      
      func (s *Service) initialize(ctx context.Context, payment db.Payment, idemKey string) (CreateResult, error) {
        checkout, err := s.provider.InitializeTransaction(ctx, providers.InitializeRequest{
          Reference:   payment.Reference,
          Amount:      payment.Amount,
          Currency:    payment.Currency,
          Email:       payment.CustomerEmail,
          CallbackURL: payment.ReturnURL,
        })
        if err != nil {
          return CreateResult{}, fmt.Errorf("payments: initialize transaction: %w", err)
        }
      
        if err := s.store.UpdatePaymentCheckout(ctx, payment.ID, checkout.AuthorizationURL); err != nil {
          return CreateResult{}, fmt.Errorf("payments: save checkout url: %w", err)
        }
      
        result := CreateResult{
          PaymentID:   payment.ID.String(),
          OrderID:     payment.OrderID,
          Status:      payment.Status,
          Amount:      payment.Amount,
          Currency:    payment.Currency,
          CheckoutURL: checkout.AuthorizationURL,
        }
      
        raw, err := json.Marshal(result)
        if err != nil {
          return CreateResult{}, fmt.Errorf("payments: encode response: %w", err)
        }
        if err := s.store.StoreIdempotencyResponse(ctx, db.PaymentScope+idemKey, http.StatusCreated, string(raw)); err != nil {
          return CreateResult{}, fmt.Errorf("payments: store idempotency response: %w", err)
        }
      
        return result, nil
      }
      
      func (s *Service) Get(ctx context.Context, id uuid.UUID) (Payment, error) {
        row, err := s.store.GetPaymentByID(ctx, id)
        if err != nil {
          if errors.Is(err, db.ErrNotFound) {
            return Payment{}, apperrors.New(http.StatusNotFound, "payment_not_found", "Payment not found")
          }
          return Payment{}, fmt.Errorf("payments: get payment: %w", err)
        }
      
        refunded, err := s.store.SumProcessedRefunds(ctx, id)
        if err != nil {
          return Payment{}, fmt.Errorf("payments: sum processed refunds: %w", err)
        }
      
        return Payment{
          ID:             row.ID,
          OrderID:        row.OrderID,
          Amount:         row.Amount,
          Currency:       row.Currency,
          Status:         row.Status,
          Channel:        row.Channel.String,
          AmountRefunded: refunded,
          CreatedAt:      row.CreatedAt,
        }, nil
      }
      
      
      func (s *Service) MarkSucceeded(ctx context.Context, txStore *db.Store, payment db.Payment, channel string, late bool) error {
        if payment.Status == StatusSucceeded || payment.Status == StatusPartiallyRefunded || payment.Status == StatusRefunded {
          return nil
        }
      
        if err := txStore.MarkPaymentSucceeded(ctx, payment.ID, channel, late); err != nil {
          return fmt.Errorf("payments: mark succeeded: %w", err)
        }
      
        return callbacks.Enqueue(ctx, txStore, callbacks.EventPaymentSucceeded, callbacks.EventData{
          PaymentID:      payment.ID.String(),
          OrderID:        payment.OrderID,
          Status:         StatusSucceeded,
          Amount:         payment.Amount,
          AmountRefunded: 0,
          Currency:       payment.Currency,
          Late:           late,
        })
      }
      
      
      func (s *Service) MarkExpired(ctx context.Context, txStore *db.Store, payment db.Payment) error {
        if payment.Status != StatusPending {
          return nil
        }
      
        if err := txStore.MarkPaymentExpired(ctx, payment.ID); err != nil {
          return fmt.Errorf("payments: mark expired: %w", err)
        }
      
        return callbacks.Enqueue(ctx, txStore, callbacks.EventPaymentExpired, callbacks.EventData{
          PaymentID:      payment.ID.String(),
          OrderID:        payment.OrderID,
          Status:         StatusExpired,
          Amount:         payment.Amount,
          AmountRefunded: 0,
          Currency:       payment.Currency,
          Late:           false,
        })
      }
      
      
      func (s *Service) ApplyRefundProcessed(ctx context.Context, txStore *db.Store, refund db.Refund) error {
        if err := txStore.MarkRefundProcessed(ctx, refund.ID, refund.PaystackRefundID.Int64); err != nil {
          return fmt.Errorf("payments: mark refund processed: %w", err)
        }
      
        payment, err := txStore.GetPaymentByIDForUpdate(ctx, refund.PaymentID)
        if err != nil {
          return fmt.Errorf("payments: lock payment after refund: %w", err)
        }
      
        total, err := txStore.SumProcessedRefunds(ctx, payment.ID)
        if err != nil {
          return fmt.Errorf("payments: sum processed refunds: %w", err)
        }
      
        if err := txStore.SetPaymentRefundState(ctx, payment.ID, total); err != nil {
          return fmt.Errorf("payments: set refund state: %w", err)
        }
      
        newStatus := StatusPartiallyRefunded
        if total >= payment.Amount {
          newStatus = StatusRefunded
        }
      
        return callbacks.Enqueue(ctx, txStore, callbacks.EventPaymentRefunded, callbacks.EventData{
          PaymentID:      payment.ID.String(),
          OrderID:        payment.OrderID,
          Status:         newStatus,
          Amount:         payment.Amount,
          AmountRefunded: total,
          Currency:       payment.Currency,
          Late:           payment.Late,
        })
      }
      func requestHash(parts ...string) string {
        joined := make([]byte, 0, 128)
        for i, part := range parts {
          if i > 0 {
            joined = append(joined, 0x1f)
          }
          joined = append(joined, part...)
        }
        sum := sha256.Sum256(joined)
        return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
      }
      
      
      func (s *Service) ApplyRefundFailed(ctx context.Context, txStore *db.Store, refundID uuid.UUID) error {
        refund, err := txStore.GetRefundByIDForUpdate(ctx, refundID)
        if err != nil {
          return fmt.Errorf("payments: lock refund for failure: %w", err)
        }
      
        if err := txStore.MarkRefundFailed(ctx, refund.ID); err != nil {
          return fmt.Errorf("payments: mark refund failed: %w", err)
        }
      
        payment, err := txStore.GetPaymentByIDForUpdate(ctx, refund.PaymentID)
        if err != nil {
          return fmt.Errorf("payments: lock payment after failed refund: %w", err)
        }
      
        total, err := txStore.SumProcessedRefunds(ctx, payment.ID)
        if err != nil {
          return fmt.Errorf("payments: sum processed refunds: %w", err)
        }
      
        return callbacks.Enqueue(ctx, txStore, callbacks.EventPaymentRefundFailed, callbacks.EventData{
          PaymentID:      payment.ID.String(),
          OrderID:        payment.OrderID,
          Status:         payment.Status,
          Amount:         payment.Amount,
          AmountRefunded: total,
          Currency:       payment.Currency,
          Late:           payment.Late,
        })
      }

      package payments
      
      import (
        "encoding/json"
        "net/http"
        "net/url"
        "strings"
      
        "github.com/google/uuid"
      
        apperrors "github.com/BUCC-Backend-Team/payment_service_4/internal/errors"
      )
      
      const MaxBodyBytes = 1 << 20
      
      type apiHandler struct {
        service *Service
      }
      
      func NewHandler(service *Service) *apiHandler {
        return &apiHandler{service: service}
      }
      
      type createPaymentBody struct {
        OrderID       string `json:"orderId"`
        Amount        int64  `json:"amount"`
        Currency      string `json:"currency"`
        CustomerEmail string `json:"customerEmail"`
        ReturnURL     string `json:"returnUrl"`
      }
      
      func (h *apiHandler) Create(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
        idemKey := r.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key")
        if strings.TrimSpace(idemKey) == "" {
          WriteError(w, apperrors.New(http.StatusBadRequest, "missing_idempotency_key", "Idempotency-Key header is required"))
          return
        }
      
        var body createPaymentBody
        if !decodeJSONBody(w, r, &body) {
          return
        }
      
        req, err := validatedCreateRequest(body)
        if err != nil {
          WriteError(w, err)
          return
        }
      
        result, replayed, createErr := h.service.Create(r.Context(), req, strings.TrimSpace(idemKey))
        if createErr != nil {
          WriteError(w, createErr)
          return
        }
      
        status := http.StatusCreated
        headers := map[string]string{}
        if replayed {
          headers["Idempotent-Replayed"] = "true"
        }
        WriteJSON(w, status, result, headers)
      }
      
      func (h *apiHandler) Get(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
        paymentID, err := uuid.Parse(r.PathValue("id"))
        if err != nil {
          WriteError(w, apperrors.New(http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_payment_id", "Payment id must be a UUID"))
          return
        }
      
        payment, err := h.service.Get(r.Context(), paymentID)
        if err != nil {
          WriteError(w, err)
          return
        }
      
        WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, payment, map[string]string{})
      }
      
      func validatedCreateRequest(body createPaymentBody) (CreateRequest, error) {
        orderID := strings.TrimSpace(body.OrderID)
        if orderID == "" {
          return CreateRequest{}, apperrors.New(http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_order_id", "orderId is required")
        }
        if body.Amount <= 0 {
          return CreateRequest{}, apperrors.New(http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_amount", "amount must be a positive integer of kobo")
        }
      
        currency := strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(body.Currency))
        if currency == "" {
          currency = "NGN"
        }
        if currency != "NGN" {
          return CreateRequest{}, apperrors.New(http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_currency", "Only NGN is supported")
        }
      
        email := strings.TrimSpace(body.CustomerEmail)
        if !validEmail(email) {
          return CreateRequest{}, apperrors.New(http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_customer_email", "customerEmail must be a valid address")
        }
      
        returnURL := strings.TrimSpace(body.ReturnURL)
        parsed, err := url.Parse(returnURL)
        if err != nil || (parsed.Scheme != "http" && parsed.Scheme != "https") || parsed.Host == "" {
          return CreateRequest{}, apperrors.New(http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_return_url", "returnUrl must be an http(s) URL")
        }
      
        return CreateRequest{
          OrderID:       orderID,
          Amount:        body.Amount,
          Currency:      currency,
          CustomerEmail: email,
          ReturnURL:     returnURL,
        }, nil
      }
      
      func validEmail(email string) bool {
        at := strings.LastIndex(email, "@")
        return at > 0 && at < len(email)-1 && !strings.ContainsAny(email, " \t\r\n")
      }
      
      func decodeJSONBody(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, into any) bool {
        r.Body = http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, MaxBodyBytes)
        decoder := json.NewDecoder(r.Body)
        if err := decoder.Decode(into); err != nil {
          WriteError(w, apperrors.New(http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_request_body", "Request body must be valid JSON"))
          return false
        }
        return true
      }
      
      func WriteJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, body any, extra map[string]string) {
        for key, value := range extra {
          w.Header().Set(key, value)
        }
        w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
        w.WriteHeader(status)
        _ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(body)
      }
      
      func WriteError(w http.ResponseWriter, err error) {
        appErr, ok := err.(*apperrors.AppError)
        if !ok {
          appErr = apperrors.New(http.StatusInternalServerError, "internal_error", "Internal server error")
        }
        w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
        w.WriteHeader(appErr.HTTPStatus())
        _ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]string{"error": appErr.Code})
      }

- path: internal/refunds/service.go
  content: |
      package refunds
      
      import (
        "context"
        "crypto/sha256"
        "encoding/hex"
        "encoding/json"
        "errors"
        "fmt"
        "log/slog"
        "strconv"
        "time"
      
        "github.com/google/uuid"
      
        apperrors "github.com/BUCC-Backend-Team/payment_service_4/internal/errors"
        "github.com/BUCC-Backend-Team/payment_service_4/src/db"
        "github.com/BUCC-Backend-Team/payment_service_4/internal/payments"
        "github.com/BUCC-Backend-Team/payment_service_4/internal/providers"
      )
      
      const (
        StatusPending   = "pending"
        StatusProcessed = "processed"
        StatusFailed    = "failed"
      
        refundCallWait = 10 * time.Second
        submitAttempts = 6
      )
      
      type Result struct {
        RefundID string `json:"refundId"`
        Amount   int64  `json:"amount"`
        Status   string `json:"status"`
      }
      
      type Service struct {
        store    *db.Store
        provider providers.Provider
        payments *payments.Service
        log      *slog.Logger
      }
      
      func NewService(store *db.Store, provider providers.Provider, paymentService *payments.Service, log *slog.Logger) *Service {
        return &Service{
          store:    store,
          provider: provider,
          payments: paymentService,
          log:      log,
        }
      }
      
      
      func (s *Service) Create(ctx context.Context, paymentID uuid.UUID, idemKey string, amount int64) (Result, bool, error) {
        if idemKey == "" {
          return Result{}, false, apperrors.New(400, "missing_idempotency_key", "Idempotency-Key header is required")
        }
        if amount < 0 {
          return Result{}, false, apperrors.New(400, "invalid_amount", "amount must be a positive integer of kobo")
        }
      
        bodyHash := requestHash(strconv.FormatInt(amount, 10))
        key := db.RefundScope + idemKey
      
        rec, err := s.store.GetIdempotencyRecord(ctx, key)
        if err == nil {
          if rec.RequestHash != bodyHash {
            return Result{}, false, apperrors.New(422, "key_reuse_mismatch", "Idempotency-Key reused with a different body")
          }
          if rec.ResponseBody != "" {
            var saved Result
            if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(rec.ResponseBody), &saved); err != nil {
              return Result{}, false, fmt.Errorf("refunds: decode stored response: %w", err)
            }
            return saved, true, nil
          }
        } else if !errors.Is(err, db.ErrNotFound) {
          return Result{}, false, fmt.Errorf("refunds: read idempotency record: %w", err)
        }
      
        reserved, err := s.store.ReserveIdempotencyKey(ctx, key, bodyHash)
        if err != nil {
          return Result{}, false, fmt.Errorf("refunds: reserve idempotency key: %w", err)
        }
        if !reserved {
          return s.waitForWinner(ctx, key, bodyHash)
        }
      
        result, err := s.insertRefund(ctx, paymentID, idemKey, amount, key)
        if err != nil {
          if appErr, ok := err.(*apperrors.AppError); ok && appErr.HTTPStatus() != 500 {
            _ = s.store.DeleteIdempotencyKey(ctx, key)
          }
          return Result{}, false, err
        }
        return result, false, nil
      }
      
      func (s *Service) insertRefund(ctx context.Context, paymentID uuid.UUID, idemKey string, requested int64, key string) (Result, error) {
        tx, err := s.store.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
        if err != nil {
          return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("refunds: begin tx: %w", err)
        }
        defer func() { _ = tx.Rollback() }()
      
        txStore := db.NewStore(tx)
      
        payment, err := txStore.GetPaymentByIDForUpdate(ctx, paymentID)
        if err != nil {
          if errors.Is(err, db.ErrNotFound) {
            return Result{}, apperrors.New(404, "payment_not_found", "Payment not found")
          }
          return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("refunds: lock payment: %w", err)
        }
      
        if payment.Status != payments.StatusSucceeded && payment.Status != payments.StatusPartiallyRefunded {
          return Result{}, apperrors.New(409, "not_refundable", "Payment is not in a refundable state")
        }
      
        activeTotal, err := txStore.SumActiveRefunds(ctx, payment.ID)
        if err != nil {
          return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("refunds: sum active refunds: %w", err)
        }
      
        remaining := payment.Amount - activeTotal
        if remaining <= 0 {
          return Result{}, apperrors.New(409, "not_refundable", "There is nothing left to refund")
        }
      
        amount := requested
        if amount == 0 {
          amount = remaining
        }
        if amount > remaining {
          return Result{}, apperrors.New(409, "not_refundable", "Requested refund exceeds the remaining balance")
        }
      
        refundID := uuid.New()
        if _, err := txStore.CreateRefund(ctx, db.Refund{
          ID:        refundID,
          PaymentID: payment.ID,
          Amount:    amount,
          Status:    StatusPending,
        }); err != nil {
          return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("refunds: create refund: %w", err)
        }
      
        result := Result{
          RefundID: refundID.String(),
          Amount:   amount,
          Status:   StatusPending,
        }
      
        raw, err := json.Marshal(result)
        if err != nil {
          return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("refunds: encode response: %w", err)
        }
        if err := txStore.StoreIdempotencyResponse(ctx, key, 202, string(raw)); err != nil {
          return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("refunds: store idempotency response: %w", err)
        }
      
        if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
          return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("refunds: commit: %w", err)
        }
      
        go s.submit(context.WithoutCancel(ctx), refundID, payment.Reference, amount)
      
        return result, nil
      }
      
      func (s *Service) waitForWinner(ctx context.Context, key, bodyHash string) (Result, bool, error) {
        deadline := time.Now().Add(refundCallWait)
        for time.Now().Before(deadline) {
          select {
          case <-ctx.Done():
            return Result{}, false, ctx.Err()
          case <-time.After(40 * time.Millisecond):
          }
      
          rec, err := s.store.GetIdempotencyRecord(ctx, key)
          if err == nil {
            if rec.RequestHash != bodyHash {
              return Result{}, false, apperrors.New(422, "key_reuse_mismatch", "Idempotency-Key reused with a different body")
            }
            if rec.ResponseBody != "" {
              var saved Result
              if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(rec.ResponseBody), &saved); err != nil {
                return Result{}, false, fmt.Errorf("refunds: decode stored response: %w", err)
              }
              return saved, true, nil
            }
          } else if !errors.Is(err, db.ErrNotFound) {
            return Result{}, false, fmt.Errorf("refunds: poll idempotency record: %w", err)
          }
        }
        return Result{}, false, apperrors.New(409, "idempotency_in_progress", "A request with this Idempotency-Key is still in flight")
      }
      
      func requestHash(amount string) string {
        sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte("refund|" + amount))
        return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
      }

      package refunds
      
      import (
        "encoding/json"
        "net/http"
        "strings"
      
        "github.com/google/uuid"
      
        apperrors "github.com/BUCC-Backend-Team/payment_service_4/internal/errors"
        "github.com/BUCC-Backend-Team/payment_service_4/internal/payments"
      )
      
      type apiHandler struct {
        service *Service
      }
      
      func NewHandler(service *Service) *apiHandler {
        return &apiHandler{service: service}
      }
      
      type refundBody struct {
        Amount *int64 `json:"amount"`
      }
      
      func (h *apiHandler) Create(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
        idemKey := strings.TrimSpace(r.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key"))
        if idemKey == "" {
          payments.WriteError(w, apperrors.New(http.StatusBadRequest, "missing_idempotency_key", "Idempotency-Key header is required"))
          return
        }
      
        paymentID, err := uuid.Parse(r.PathValue("id"))
        if err != nil {
          payments.WriteError(w, apperrors.New(http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_payment_id", "Payment id must be a UUID"))
          return
        }
      
        var amount int64
        if r.ContentLength > 0 {
          var body refundBody
          decoder := json.NewDecoder(http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, payments.MaxBodyBytes))
          if err := decoder.Decode(&body); err != nil {
            payments.WriteError(w, apperrors.New(http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_request_body", "Request body must be valid JSON"))
            return
          }
          if body.Amount != nil {
            amount = *body.Amount
          }
        }
      
        result, replayed, createErr := h.service.Create(r.Context(), paymentID, idemKey, amount)
        if createErr != nil {
          payments.WriteError(w, createErr)
          return
        }
      
        headers := map[string]string{}
        if replayed {
          headers["Idempotent-Replayed"] = "true"
        }
        payments.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusAccepted, result, headers)
      }

      package webhooks
      
      import (
        "context"
        "crypto/hmac"
        "crypto/sha512"
        "crypto/subtle"
        "database/sql"
        "encoding/hex"
        "encoding/json"
        "errors"
        "io"
        "log/slog"
        "net/http"
      
        "github.com/BUCC-Backend-Team/payment_service_4/src/db"
        "github.com/BUCC-Backend-Team/payment_service_4/internal/payments"
        "github.com/BUCC-Backend-Team/payment_service_4/internal/providers"
      )
      
      const maxWebhookBody = 1 << 20
      
      type Service struct {
        store     *db.Store
        provider  providers.Provider
        payments  *payments.Service
        log       *slog.Logger
        secretKey string
      }
      
      func NewService(store *db.Store, provider providers.Provider, paymentService *payments.Service, log *slog.Logger, secretKey string) *Service {
        return &Service{
          store:     store,
          provider:  provider,
          payments:  paymentService,
          log:       log,
          secretKey: secretKey,
        }
      }
      
      
      func (s *Service) Handle(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
        body, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(r.Body, maxWebhookBody))
        if err != nil {
          w.WriteHeader(http.StatusBadRequest)
          _, _ = w.Write([]byte("unreadable body"))
          return
        }
      
        signature := r.Header.Get("x-paystack-signature")
        if !validSignature(s.secretKey, body, signature) {
          s.log.Warn("webhooks: invalid paystack signature")
          w.WriteHeader(http.StatusBadRequest)
          _, _ = w.Write([]byte("invalid signature"))
          return
        }
      
        var event PaystackEvent
        if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &event); err != nil {
          w.WriteHeader(http.StatusBadRequest)
          _, _ = w.Write([]byte("invalid payload"))
          return
        }
      
        switch event.Event {
        case "charge.success":
          s.handleChargeSuccess(r.Context(), w, event)
        case "refund.processed":
          s.handleRefundEvent(r.Context(), w, event, true)
        case "refund.failed":
          s.handleRefundEvent(r.Context(), w, event, false)
        default:
          w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
        }
      }
      
      func validSignature(secret string, body []byte, signature string) bool {
        if signature == "" || secret == "" {
          return false
        }
      
        mac := hmac.New(sha512.New, []byte(secret))
        mac.Write(body)
        expected := hex.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))
        return subtle.ConstantTimeCompare([]byte(expected), []byte(signature)) == 1
      }
      
      
      func (s *Service) handleChargeSuccess(ctx context.Context, w http.ResponseWriter, event PaystackEvent) {
        reference := event.Data.Reference
        if reference == "" {
          w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
          return
        }
      
        payment, err := s.store.GetPaymentByReference(ctx, reference)
        if err != nil {
          if errors.Is(err, db.ErrNotFound) {
            s.log.Warn("webhooks: charge.success unknown reference", "reference", reference)
            w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
            return
          }
          s.log.Error("webhooks: load payment for webhook", "error", err)
          w.WriteHeader(http.StatusInternalServerError)
          return
        }
      
        transaction, err := s.provider.VerifyTransaction(ctx, reference)
        if err != nil || !matchesPayment(transaction, payment) {
          s.log.Warn("webhooks: charge.success failed verification",
            "reference", reference,
            "verified", err == nil,
            "error", err)
          w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
          return
        }
      
        late := payment.Status == payments.StatusExpired
      
        tx, err := s.store.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
        if err != nil {
          s.log.Error("webhooks: begin tx", "error", err)
          w.WriteHeader(http.StatusInternalServerError)
          return
        }
        defer func() { _ = tx.Rollback() }()
      
        txStore := db.NewStore(tx)
      
        dedup := DeduplicationKey(event)
        delivered, err := txStore.RecordProcessedEvent(ctx, dedup)
        if err != nil {
          s.log.Error("webhooks: record dedup key", "error", err)
          w.WriteHeader(http.StatusInternalServerError)
          return
        }
        if !delivered {
          s.log.Warn("webhooks: duplicate charge.success ignored", "reference", reference)
          w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
          return
        }
      
        if err := s.payments.MarkSucceeded(ctx, txStore, payment, transaction.Channel, late); err != nil {
          s.log.Error("webhooks: mark payment succeeded", "error", err)
          return
        }
      
        if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
          s.log.Error("webhooks: commit succeeded tx", "error", err)
          return
        }
      
        w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
      }
      
      
      func (s *Service) handleRefundEvent(ctx context.Context, w http.ResponseWriter, event PaystackEvent, processed bool) {
        reference := event.Data.TransactionReferenceOf()
        if reference == "" {
          w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
          return
        }
      
        payment, err := s.store.GetPaymentByReference(ctx, reference)
        if err != nil {
          if errors.Is(err, db.ErrNotFound) {
            s.log.Warn("webhooks: refund event unknown reference", "reference", reference)
            w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
            return
          }
          s.log.Error("webhooks: load payment for refund webhook", "error", err)
          w.WriteHeader(http.StatusInternalServerError)
          return
        }
      
        tx, err := s.store.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
        if err != nil {
          s.log.Error("webhooks: begin refund event tx", "error", err)
          w.WriteHeader(http.StatusInternalServerError)
          return
        }
        defer func() { _ = tx.Rollback() }()
      
        txStore := db.NewStore(tx)
      
        dedup := DeduplicationKey(event)
        delivered, err := txStore.RecordProcessedEvent(ctx, dedup)
        if err != nil {
          s.log.Error("webhooks: record dedup key", "error", err)
          w.WriteHeader(http.StatusInternalServerError)
          return
        }
        if !delivered {
          s.log.Warn("webhooks: duplicate refund event ignored", "reference", reference)
          w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
          return
        }
      
        active, err := txStore.ListActiveRefundsByPaymentID(ctx, payment.ID)
        if err != nil {
          s.log.Error("webhooks: list active refunds", "error", err)
          return
        }
      
        refund, found := matchRefund(active, event.Data)
        if !found {
          _ = tx.Rollback()
          s.log.Warn("webhooks: refund event has no matching pending refund", "reference", reference)
          w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
          return
        }
      
        var applyErr error
        if processed {
          if event.Data.ID > 0 {
            refund.PaystackRefundID = toNullInt64(event.Data.ID)
          }
          applyErr = s.payments.ApplyRefundProcessed(ctx, txStore, refund)
        } else {
          applyErr = s.payments.ApplyRefundFailed(ctx, txStore, refund.ID)
        }
        if applyErr != nil {
          s.log.Error("webhooks: apply refund event", "error", applyErr)
          return
        }
      
        if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
          s.log.Error("webhooks: commit refund event tx", "error", err)
          return
        }
      
        w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
      }
      
      
      func matchRefund(active []db.Refund, data EventData) (db.Refund, bool) {
        if data.ID > 0 {
          for _, refund := range active {
            if refund.PaystackRefundID.Valid && refund.PaystackRefundID.Int64 == data.ID {
              return refund, true
            }
          }
        }
      
        refundAmount := data.RefundAmount()
        for _, refund := range active {
          if refund.Status != "pending" {
            continue
          }
          if refundAmount <= 0 || refundAmount == refund.Amount {
            return refund, true
          }
        }
        return db.Refund{}, false
      }
      
      func matchesPayment(transaction providers.Transaction, payment db.Payment) bool {
        return transaction.Status == "success" &&
          transaction.Amount == payment.Amount &&
          transaction.Currency == payment.Currency
      }
      
      func toNullInt64(v int64) sql.NullInt64 {
        if v <= 0 {
          return sql.NullInt64{}
        }
        return sql.NullInt64{Int64: v, Valid: true}
      }

      package refunds
      
      import (
        "context"
        "time"
      
        "github.com/google/uuid"
      
        "github.com/BUCC-Backend-Team/payment_service_4/src/db"
        "github.com/BUCC-Backend-Team/payment_service_4/internal/providers"
      )
      
      
      func (s *Service) submit(ctx context.Context, refundID uuid.UUID, transactionReference string, amount int64) {
        outcome := providers.Refund{}
        ambiguous := false
      
        delay := 1 * time.Second
        for attempt := 1; attempt <= submitAttempts; attempt++ {
          if attempt > 1 {
            select {
            case <-ctx.Done():
              return
            case <-time.After(delay):
            }
            delay *= 2
          }
      
          refund, err := s.provider.CreateRefund(ctx, providers.RefundRequest{
            Transaction: transactionReference,
            Amount:      amount,
          })
          if err == nil {
            outcome = refund
            ambiguous = false
            break
          }
      
          if providers.IsRejection(err) {
            s.failRefund(ctx, refundID, err)
            return
          }
      
          if attempt < submitAttempts {
            s.log.Warn("refunds: retrying Paystack refund",
              "refundId", refundID, "attempt", attempt, "error", err)
          } else {
            ambiguous = true
          }
        }
      
        if outcome.ID > 0 {
          if err := s.store.SetRefundPaystackID(ctx, refundID, outcome.ID); err != nil {
            s.log.Error("refunds: save paystack refund id", "refundId", refundID, "error", err)
          }
        }
      
        if ambiguous {
          s.log.Warn("refunds: outcome uncertain after retries; leaving pending for reconciliation",
            "refundId", refundID)
        }
      }
      
      
      func (s *Service) failRefund(ctx context.Context, refundID uuid.UUID, cause error) {
        s.log.Warn("refunds: paystack rejected refund", "refundId", refundID, "error", cause)
      
        tx, err := s.store.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
        if err != nil {
          s.log.Error("refunds: begin fail tx", "refundId", refundID, "error", err)
          return
        }
        defer func() { _ = tx.Rollback() }()
      
        txStore := db.NewStore(tx)
        if _, err := txStore.GetRefundByIDForUpdate(ctx, refundID); err != nil {
          s.log.Error("refunds: cannot fail unknown refund", "refundId", refundID, "error", err)
          return
        }
      
        if err := s.payments.ApplyRefundFailed(ctx, txStore, refundID); err != nil {
          s.log.Error("refunds: apply refund failed state", "refundId", refundID, "error", err)
          return
        }
      
        if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
          s.log.Error("refunds: commit fail tx", "refundId", refundID, "error", err)
        }
      }

      package webhooks
      
      import (
        "fmt"
      )
      
      
      type PaystackEvent struct {
        Event string `json:"event"`
        Data  EventData `json:"data"`
      }
      
      type EventData struct {
        ID                   int64  `json:"id"`
        Reference            string `json:"reference"`
        TransactionReference string `json:"transaction_reference"`
        Amount               int64  `json:"amount"`
        Transaction struct {
          Reference string `json:"reference"`
          Amount    int64  `json:"amount"`
        } `json:"transaction"`
      }
      
      
      func (d EventData) TransactionReferenceOf() string {
        if d.TransactionReference != "" {
          return d.TransactionReference
        }
        if d.Transaction.Reference != "" {
          return d.Transaction.Reference
        }
        return d.Reference
      }
      
      
      func (d EventData) RefundAmount() int64 {
        if d.Amount > 0 {
          return d.Amount
        }
        return d.Transaction.Amount
      }
      
      func DeduplicationKey(event PaystackEvent) string {
        if event.Data.ID != 0 {
          return fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", event.Event, event.Data.ID)
        }
        return event.Event + ":" + event.Data.TransactionReferenceOf()
      }

      package api
      
      import (
        "crypto/subtle"
        "net/http"
        "strings"
      
        apperrors "github.com/BUCC-Backend-Team/payment_service_4/internal/errors"
        "github.com/BUCC-Backend-Team/payment_service_4/internal/payments"
      )
      
      // reject requests without Authorization: Bearer MERCHANT_API_KEY.
      func MerchantGuard(expected string) func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
        return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
          return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
            provided, ok := bearerToken(r.Header.Get("Authorization"))
            if !ok || subtle.ConstantTimeCompare([]byte(provided), []byte(expected)) != 1 {
              payments.WriteError(w, apperrors.New(http.StatusUnauthorized, "unauthorized", "Authorization: Bearer <MERCHANT_API_KEY> required"))
              return
            }
            next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
          })
        }
      }
      
      func bearerToken(header string) (string, bool) {
        rest, found := strings.CutPrefix(header, "Bearer ")
        if !found {
          rest, found = strings.CutPrefix(header, "bearer ")
        }
        if !found || strings.TrimSpace(rest) == "" {
          return "", false
        }
        return strings.TrimSpace(rest), true
      }
      
      
      func Health() http.HandlerFunc {
        return func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
          w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
          w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
          _, _ = w.Write([]byte(`{"status":"ok"}`))
        }
      }

      package providers
      
      import (
        "bytes"
        "context"
        "encoding/json"
        "errors"
        "fmt"
        "io"
        "log/slog"
        "net"
        "net/http"
        "net/url"
        "strings"
        "time"
      )
      
      //whether a failed Paystack call can be retried safely.
      type Class int
      
      const (
        ClassReject   Class = iota
        ClassRetry
        ClassAmbiguous
      )
      
      type ProviderCallError struct {
        Class     Class
        HTTPStat  int
        Message   string
        Retryable bool
      }
      
      func (e *ProviderCallError) Error() string {
        return fmt.Sprintf("paystack call failed: class=%d http=%d message=%q retryable=%t", e.Class, e.HTTPStat, e.Message, e.Retryable)
      }
      
      // RetriablePaystackErr tells callers whether a failed call should be retried.
      func RetriablePaystackErr(err error) bool {
        e, ok := err.(*ProviderCallError)
        if !ok {
          return false
        }
        return e.Class != ClassReject
      }
      
      func IsRetryable(err error) bool {
        call, ok := err.(*ProviderCallError)
        if !ok {
          return true
        }
        return call.Class != ClassReject
      }
      
      func IsRejection(err error) bool {
        e, ok := err.(*ProviderCallError)
        if !ok {
          return false
        }
        return e.Class == ClassReject
      }
      
      type PaystackProvider struct {
        SecretKey string
        BaseURL   string
        HTTP      *http.Client
        Logger    *slog.Logger
      }
      
      func NewPaystack(secretKey string, logger *slog.Logger) *PaystackProvider {
        return &PaystackProvider{
          SecretKey: secretKey,
          BaseURL:   "https://api.paystack.co",
          HTTP: &http.Client{
            Timeout: 30 * time.Second,
          },
          Logger: logger,
        }
      }
      
      type paystackEnvelope struct {
        Status  bool            `json:"status"`
        Message string          `json:"message"`
        Data    json.RawMessage `json:"data"`
      }
      
      type paystackInitData struct {
        AuthorizationURL string `json:"authorization_url"`
        AccessCode       string `json:"access_code"`
        Reference        string `json:"reference"`
      }
      
      type paystackVerifyData struct {
        Reference string `json:"reference"`
        Status    string `json:"status"`
        Amount    int64  `json:"amount"`
        Currency  string `json:"currency"`
        Channel   string `json:"channel"`
      }
      
      type paystackRefundData struct {
        ID       int64  `json:"id"`
        Status   string `json:"status"`
        Amount   int64  `json:"amount"`
        Currency string `json:"currency"`
      }
      
      func (p *PaystackProvider) do(ctx context.Context, method, path string, payload any) (paystackEnvelope, error) {
        var bodyReader io.Reader
        if payload != nil {
          encoded, err := json.Marshal(payload)
          if err != nil {
            return paystackEnvelope{}, fmt.Errorf("provider: encode request: %w", err)
          }
          bodyReader = bytes.NewReader(encoded)
        }
      
        req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, method, p.BaseURL+path, bodyReader)
        if err != nil {
          return paystackEnvelope{}, fmt.Errorf("provider: build request: %w", err)
        }
        req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+p.SecretKey)
        req.Header.Set("Accept", "application/json")
        if payload != nil {
          req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
        }
      
        resp, err := p.HTTP.Do(req)
        if err != nil {
          if errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) || isNetTimeout(err) {
            return paystackEnvelope{}, providerErr(ClassAmbiguous, 0, "request timed out")
          }
          return paystackEnvelope{}, providerErr(ClassRetry, 0, err.Error())
        }
        defer resp.Body.Close()
      
        raw, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(resp.Body, 1<<20))
        if err != nil {
          return paystackEnvelope{}, providerErr(ClassAmbiguous, resp.StatusCode, "unreadable Paystack response")
        }
      
        var envelope paystackEnvelope
        if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &envelope); err != nil {
          return paystackEnvelope{}, providerErr(ClassAmbiguous, resp.StatusCode, fmt.Sprintf("bad Paystack response: %v", err))
        }
      
        if resp.StatusCode >= 500 {
          return paystackEnvelope{}, providerErr(ClassAmbiguous, resp.StatusCode, envelope.Message)
        }
        if resp.StatusCode == http.StatusTooManyRequests {
          return paystackEnvelope{}, providerErr(ClassRetry, resp.StatusCode, envelope.Message)
        }
        if resp.StatusCode >= 400 {
          return paystackEnvelope{}, providerErr(ClassReject, resp.StatusCode, envelope.Message)
        }
        if !envelope.Status {
          return paystackEnvelope{}, providerErr(ClassReject, resp.StatusCode, envelope.Message)
        }
      
        return envelope, nil
      }
      
      func providerErr(class Class, status int, message string) *ProviderCallError {
        return &ProviderCallError{
          Class:     class,
          HTTPStat:  status,
          Message:   message,
          Retryable: class != ClassReject,
        }
      }
      
      func isNetTimeout(err error) bool {
        var netErr net.Error
        return errors.As(err, &netErr) && netErr.Timeout()
      }
      
      func (p *PaystackProvider) InitializeTransaction(ctx context.Context, req InitializeRequest) (Checkout, error) {
        envelope, err := p.do(ctx, http.MethodPost, "/transaction/initialize", map[string]any{
          "email":        req.Email,
          "amount":       req.Amount,
          "currency":     req.Currency,
          "reference":    req.Reference,
          "callback_url": req.CallbackURL,
          "channels":     []string{"card", "bank_transfer"},
        })
        if err != nil {
          return Checkout{}, err
        }
      
        var data paystackInitData
        if err := json.Unmarshal(envelope.Data, &data); err != nil {
          return Checkout{}, providerErr(ClassAmbiguous, 0, "bad Paystack initialize payload")
        }
      
        if strings.TrimSpace(data.AuthorizationURL) == "" {
          return Checkout{}, providerErr(ClassAmbiguous, 0, "Paystack returned no authorization URL")
        }
        if data.Reference != req.Reference {
          return Checkout{}, providerErr(ClassAmbiguous, 0, "Paystack returned a mismatched reference")
        }
      
        return Checkout{
          AuthorizationURL: data.AuthorizationURL,
          AccessCode:       data.AccessCode,
          Reference:        data.Reference,
        }, nil
      }
      
      func (p *PaystackProvider) VerifyTransaction(ctx context.Context, reference string) (Transaction, error) {
        envelope, err := p.do(ctx, http.MethodGet, "/transaction/verify/"+url.PathEscape(reference), nil)
        if err != nil {
          return Transaction{}, err
        }
      
        var data paystackVerifyData
        if err := json.Unmarshal(envelope.Data, &data); err != nil {
          return Transaction{}, providerErr(ClassAmbiguous, 0, "bad Paystack verify payload")
        }
      
        return Transaction{
          Reference: data.Reference,
          Status:    data.Status,
          Amount:    data.Amount,
          Currency:  data.Currency,
          Channel:   data.Channel,
        }, nil
      }
      
      func (p *PaystackProvider) CreateRefund(ctx context.Context, req RefundRequest) (Refund, error) {
        envelope, err := p.do(ctx, http.MethodPost, "/refund", map[string]any{
          "transaction": req.Transaction,
          "amount":      req.Amount,
        })
        if err != nil {
          return Refund{}, err
        }
      
        var data paystackRefundData
        if err := json.Unmarshal(envelope.Data, &data); err != nil {
          return Refund{}, providerErr(ClassAmbiguous, 0, "bad Paystack refund payload")
        }
      
        return Refund{
          ID:     data.ID,
          Status: data.Status,
          Amount: data.Amount,
        }, nil
      }

      package webhooks
      
      import (
        "encoding/json"
        "testing"
      )
      
      func TestDeduplicationKeyUsesEventAndID(t *testing.T) {
        event := PaystackEvent{
          Event: "charge.success",
          Data:  EventData{ID: 424242, Reference: "pay-ref-1"},
        }
      
        got := DeduplicationKey(event)
        if got != "charge.success:424242" {
          t.Fatalf("DeduplicationKey() = %q, want charge.success:424242", got)
        }
      }
      
      func TestDeduplicationKeyFallsBackToReference(t *testing.T) {
        event := PaystackEvent{
          Event:        "charge.success",
          Data:         EventData{Reference: "pay-ref-1"},
        }
      
        got := DeduplicationKey(event)
        if got != "charge.success:pay-ref-1" {
          t.Fatalf("DeduplicationKey() = %q, want charge.success:pay-ref-1", got)
        }
      }
      
      func TestTransactionReferenceOf(t *testing.T) {
        tests := []struct {
          name string
          data EventData
          want string
        }{
          {"explicit transaction_reference", EventData{TransactionReference: "tref"}, "tref"},
          {"nested transaction reference", EventData{Transaction: struct {
            Reference string `json:"reference"`
            Amount    int64  `json:"amount"`
          }{Reference: "nested"}}, "nested"},
          {"fallback to reference", EventData{Reference: "plain"}, "plain"},
        }
      
        for _, tt := range tests {
          t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
            if got := tt.data.TransactionReferenceOf(); got != tt.want {
              t.Fatalf("TransactionReferenceOf() = %q, want %q", got, tt.want)
            }
          })
        }
      }
      
      func TestRefundAmount(t *testing.T) {
        data := EventData{Amount: 700}
        if got := data.RefundAmount(); got != 700 {
          t.Fatalf("RefundAmount() = %d, want 700", got)
        }
      
        nested := EventData{Transaction: struct {
          Reference string `json:"reference"`
          Amount    int64  `json:"amount"`
        }{Reference: "r", Amount: 300}}
        if got := nested.RefundAmount(); got != 300 {
          t.Fatalf("RefundAmount() nested = %d, want 300", got)
        }
      }
      
      func TestEventDataJSONUnmarshal(t *testing.T) {
        raw := []byte(`{"event":"refund.processed","data":{"id":77,"amount":1234,"transaction_reference":"txref"}}`)

      package callbacks
      
      import (
        "crypto/hmac"
        "crypto/sha256"
        "encoding/hex"
        "testing"
        "time"
      )
      
      func TestSignFormat(t *testing.T) {
        secret := "test_secret"
        body := []byte(`{"id":"123"}`)
        ts := time.Unix(1700000000, 0)
      
        got := Sign(secret, ts, body)
      
        wantMAC := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte(secret))
        _, _ = wantMAC.Write([]byte("1700000000."))
        _, _ = wantMAC.Write(body)
        want := "t=1700000000,v1=" + hex.EncodeToString(wantMAC.Sum(nil))
      
        if got != want {
          t.Fatalf("Sign() = %q, want %q (format t=unix,v1=hmac-ts.body)", got, want)
        }
      }
      
      func TestSignIsBodySensitive(t *testing.T) {
        secret := "test_secret"
        ts := time.Now().Unix()
      
        one := Sign(secret, time.Unix(ts, 0), []byte("one"))
        two := Sign(secret, time.Unix(ts, 0), []byte("two"))
      
        if one == two {
          t.Fatal("signatures for different bodies must differ")
        }
      }
      
      func TestSignIsSecretSensitive(t *testing.T) {
        body := []byte("payload")
        ts := time.Unix(42, 0)
      
        first := Sign("secret_a", ts, body)
        second := Sign("secret_b", ts, body)
      
        if first == second {
          t.Fatal("signatures for different secrets must differ")
        }
      }
      
      func TestEnvelopeJSONShape(t *testing.T) {
        event := Event{
          Type: EventPaymentSucceeded,
          Data: EventData{
            PaymentID:      "pay-1",
            OrderID:        "order-1",
            Status:         "succeeded",
            Amount:         5000,
            AmountRefunded: 0,
            Currency:       "NGN",
            Late:           false,
          },
        }
      
        if event.Type != "payment.succeeded" {
          t.Errorf("event type = %q", event.Type)
        }
        if event.Data.Currency != "NGN" {
          t.Errorf("currency = %q", event.Data.Currency)
        }
      }

          t.Fatalf("decode body %q: %v", recorder.Body.String(), err)

        }
      }

        WriteJSON(recorder, http.StatusCreated, bytes.NewBufferString("ignored").String(), map[string]string{

          t.Fatalf("status = %d, want 201", recorder.Code)
        }

        }

  "content": "package callbacks\n\nimport (\n\t\"bytes\"\n\t\"context\"\n\t\"database/sql\"\n\t\"io\"\n\t\"log/slog\"\n\t\"net/http\"\n\t\"time\"\n\n\t\"github.com/google/uuid\"\n\n\t\"github.com/BUCC-Backend-Team/payment_service_4/internal/database\"\n)\n\nconst (\n\tmaxOutboxAttempts = 1_000_000\n\tmaxDeliveryBatch  = 25\n\tdeliveryTimeout   = 10 * time.Second\n)\n\ntype Worker struct {\n\tURL      string\n\tSecret   string\n\tStore    *database.Queries\n\tInterval time.Duration\n\tLog      *slog.Logger\n\tHTTP     *http.Client\n\n\tBackoffBase time.Duration\n}\n\nfunc NewWorker(url, secret string, store *database.Queries, interval time.Duration, log *slog.Logger) *Worker {\n\tif interval <= 0 {\n\t\tinterval = time.Second\n\t}\n\treturn &Worker{\n\t\tURL:         url,\n\t\tSecret:      secret,\n\t\tStore:       store,\n\t\tInterval:    interval,\n\t\tLog:         log,\n\t\tHTTP:        &http.Client{Timeout: deliveryTimeout},\n\t\tBackoffBase: time.Second,\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (w *Worker) Run(ctx context.Context) {\n\tticker := time.NewTicker(w.Interval)\n\tdefer ticker.Stop()\n\n\tfor {\n\t\tselect {\n\t\tcase <-ctx.Done():\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\tcase <-ticker.C:\n\t\t\tw.deliverOnce(ctx)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (w *Worker) deliverOnce(ctx context.Context) {\n\ttx, err := w.Store.BeginTx(ctx, nil)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tw.Log.Error(\"callbacks: begin outbox tx\", \"error\", err)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tdefer func() { _ = tx.Rollback() }()\n\n\ttxStore := w.Store.WithTx(tx)\n\n\tdue, err := txStore.ListDueCallbacks(ctx, database.ListDueCallbacksParams{\n\t\tAttempts: maxOutboxAttempts,\n\t\tLimit:    maxDeliveryBatch,\n\t})\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tw.Log.Error(\"callbacks: list due callbacks\", \"error\", err)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\tfor _, callback := range due {\n\t\tdelivered, err2 := w.deliver(ctx, callback.Payload)\n\t\tif err2 != nil {\n\t\t\tw.Log.Error(\"callbacks: delivery error\", \"id\", callback.ID, \"error\", err2)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif delivered {\n\t\t\tif err := txStore.MarkCallbackDelivered(ctx, callback.ID); err != nil {\n\t\t\t\tw.Log.Error(\"callbacks: mark delivered\", \"id\", callback.ID, \"error\", err)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err := txStore.MarkCallbackFailed(ctx, database.MarkCallbackFailedParams{\n\t\t\tID:      callback.ID,\n\t\t\tColumn2: w.retryDelay(callback.Attempts).Seconds(),\n\t\t}); err != nil {\n\t\t\tw.Log.Error(\"callbacks: schedule retry\", \"id\", callback.ID, \"error\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tif err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {\n\t\tw.Log.Error(\"callbacks: commit outbox tx\", \"error\", err)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (w *Worker) retryDelay(attempt int) time.Duration {\n\tif attempt < 0 {\n\t\tattempt = 0\n\t}\n\tif attempt > 3 {\n\t\tattempt = 3\n\t}\n\tbase := w.BackoffBase\n\tif base <= 0 {\n\t\tbase = time.Second\n\t}\n\treturn (1 << attempt) * base\n}\n\nfunc (w *Worker) deliver(ctx context.Context, payload []byte) (bool, error) {\n\tdeliverCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, deliveryTimeout)\n\tdefer cancel()\n\n\treq, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(deliverCtx, http.MethodPost, w.URL, bytes.NewReader(payload))\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn false, err\n\t}\n\treq.Header.Set(\"Content-Type\", \"application/json\")\n\treq.Header.Set(\"X-MarketlySignature\", Sign(w.Secret, time.Now(), payload))\n\n\tresp, err := w.HTTP.Do(req)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tw.Log.Warn(\"callbacks: delivery failed\", \"id\", req.URL, \"error\", err)\n\t\treturn false, nil\n\t}\n\tdefer func() { _ = resp.Body.Close() }()\n\t_, _ = io.Copy(io.Discard, resp.Body)\n\n\treturn resp.StatusCode >= 200 && resp.StatusCode <= 299, nil\n}\n\nvar _ = sql.NoRows\n"
}

callbacks.EventData{\n\t\tPaymentID:      payment.ID.String(),\n\t\tOrderID:        payment.OrderID,\n\t\tStatus:         newStatus,\n\t\tAmount:         payment.Amount,\n\t\tAmountRefunded: total,\n\t\tCurrency:       payment.Currency,\n\t\tLate:           payment.Late,\n\t})\n}\n\nfunc (s *Service) ApplyRefundFailed(ctx context.Context, txStore *database.Queries, refundID uuid.UUID) refund.PaymentID)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"payments: lock payment after failed refund: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\ttotal, err := txStore.SumProcessedRefunds(ctx, payment.ID)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"payments: sum processed refunds: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\treturn callbacks.Enqueue(ctx, txStore, callbacks.EventPaymentRefundFailed, callbacks.EventData{\n\t\tPaymentID:      payment.ID.String(),\n\t\tOrderID:        payment.OrderID,\n\t\tStatus:         payment.Status,\n\t\tAmount:         payment.Amount,\n\t\tAmountRefunded: total,\n\t\tCurrency:       payment.Currency,\n\t\tLate:           payment.Late,\n\t})\n}\n\nfunc requestHash(parts ...string) string {\n\tjoined := make([]byte, 0, 128)\n\tfor i, part := range parts {\n\t\tif i > 0 {\n\t\t\tjoined = append(joined, 0x1f)\n\t\t}\n\t\tjoined = append(joined, part...)\n\t}\n\tsum := sha256.Sum256(joined)\n\treturn hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])\n}\n\nfunc isUniqueViolation(err error) bool {\n\tvar pqErr *pq.Error\n\treturn errors.As(err, &pqErr) && pqErr.Code == pqUniqueViolation\n}\n\nconst pqUniqueViolation = \"23505\"\n"

{
  "path": "internal/refunds/submit.go",
  "instructions": "Adapt refund ASI submission and failure finalization to the sqlc layer.",
  "content": "package refunds\n\nimport (\n\t\"context\"\n\t\"database/sql\"\n\t\"log/slog\"\n\t\"time\"\n\n\t\"github.com/google/uuid\"\n\n\t\"github.com/BUCC-Backend-Team/payment_service_4/internal/database\"\n\t\"github.com/BUCC-Backend-Team/payment_service_4/internal/providers\"\n)\n\nfunc (s *Service) submit(ctx context.Context, refundID uuid.UUID, transactionReference string, amount int64) {\n\toutcome := providers.Refund{}\n\tambiguous := false\n\n\tdelay := submitBackoffBase\n\tfor attempt := 1; attempt <= submitAttempts; attempt++ {\n\t\tif attempt > 1 {\n\t\t\tselect {\n\t\t\tcase <-ctx.Done():\n\t\t\t\treturn\n\t\t\tcase <-time.After(delay):\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tdelay *= 2\n\t\t}\n\n\t\trefund, err := s.provider.CreateRefund(ctx, providers.RefundRequest{\n\t\t\tTransaction: transactionReference,\n\t\t\tAmount:      amount,\n\t\t})\n\t\tif err == nil {\n\t\t\toutcome = refund\n\t\t\tambiguous = false\n\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif providers.IsRejection(err) {\n\t\t\ts.failRefund(ctx, refundID, err)\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif attempt < submitAttempts {\n\t\t\ts.log.Warn(\"refunds: retrying Paystack refund\",\n\t\t\t\t\"refundId\", refundID, \"attempt\", attempt, \"error\", err)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tambiguous = true\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tif outcome.ID > 0 {\n\t\tif err := s.store.SetRefundPaystackID(ctx, database.SetRefundPaystackIDParams{\n\t\t\tID:               refundID,\n\t\t\tPaystackRefundID: sql.NullInt64{Int64: outcome.ID, Valid: true},\n\t\t}); err != nil {\n\t\t\ts.log.Error(\"refunds: save paystack refund id\", \"refundId\", refundID, \"error\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tif ambiguous {\n\t\ts.log.Warn(\"refunds: outcome uncertain after retries; leaving pending for reconciliation\", \"refundId\", refundID)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (s *Service) failRefund(ctx context.Context, refundID uuid.UUID, cause error) {\n\ts.log.Warn(\"refunds: paystack rejected refund\", \"refundId\", refundID, \"error\", cause)\n\n\ttx, err := s.store.BeginTx(ctx, nil)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\ts.log.Error(\"refunds: begin fail tx\", \"refundId\", refundID, \"error\", err)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tdefer func() { _ = tx.Rollback() }()\n\n\ttxStore := s.store.WithTx(tx)\n\tif _, err := txStore.GetRefundByIDForUpdate(ctx, refundID); err != nil {\n\t\ts.log.Error(\"refunds: cannot fail unknown refund\", \"refundId\", refundID, \"error\", err)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\tif err := s.payments.ApplyRefundFailed(ctx, txStore, refundID); err != nil {\n\t\ts.log.Error(\"refunds: apply refund failed state\", \"refundId\", refundID, \"error\", err)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\tif err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {\n\t\ts.log.Error(\"refunds: commit fail tx\", \"refundId\", refundID, \"error\", err)\n\t}\n}\n"
}

err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"jobs: mark succeeded: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\treturn tx.Commit()\n}\n\nfunc (s *Service) markExpired(ctx context.Context, id uuid.UUID) error {\n\ttx, err := s.store.BeginTx(ctx, nil)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"jobs: begin expired tx: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\tdefer func() { _ = tx.Rollback() }()\n\n\ttxStore := s.store.WithTx(tx)\n\n\tpayment, err := txStore.GetPaymentByIDForUpdate(ctx, id)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tif errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows) {\n\t\t\treturn nil\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"jobs: lock payment by id: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\tif err := s.payments.MarkExpired(ctx, txStore, payment); err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"jobs: mark expired: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\treturn tx.Commit()\n}\n\nfunc (s *Service) reconcileRefunds(ctx context.Context) error {\n\tstuck, err := s.store.ListStuckPendingRefunds(ctx, database.ListStuckPendingRefundsParams{\n\t\tColumn1: s.refundGrace.Seconds(),\n\t\tLimit:   s.batchSize,\n\t})\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"jobs: list stuck pending refunds: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\tfor _, refund := range stuck {\n\t\tif ctx.Err() != nil {\n\t\t\treturn ctx.Err()\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err := s.reconcileOneRefund(ctx, refund); err != nil {\n\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"jobs: mark stuck refund failed: %w\", err)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\treturn tx.Commit()\n\t\t}\n\t\ts.log.Warn(\"jobs: stuck refund still ambiguous, remains pending\", \"refundId\", refund.ID)\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\n\tif refundResult.ID > 0 {\n\t\tif err := txStore.SetRefundPaystackID(ctx, database.SetRefundPaystackIDParams{\n\t\t\tID:               refund.ID,\n\t\t\tPaystackRefundID: sql.NullInt64{Int64: refundResult.ID, Valid: true},\n\t\t}); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"jobs: save paystack refund id: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treturn tx.Commit()\n}\n\nvar _ = time.Second\n"

func registerRoutes(mux *http.ServeMux, paymentService *payments.Service, refundService *refunds.Service, webhookService *webhooks.Service, testMode bool) {
  paymentsHandler := payments.NewHandler(paymentService)
  refundHandler := refunds.NewHandler(refundService)
  guard := api.MerchantGuard(config.Config.MerchantAPIKey)

  mux.Handle("POST /payments", guard(http.HandlerFunc(paymentsHandler.Create)))
  mux.Handle("GET /payments/{id}", guard(http.HandlerFunc(paymentsHandler.Get)))

  mux.Handle("POST /payments/{id}/refunds", guard(http.HandlerFunc(refundHandler.Create)))

  mux.HandleFunc("GET /health", api.Health())

  mux.Handle("POST /webhooks/paystack", http.HandlerFunc(webhookService.Handle))

  mux.Handle("POST /admin/reset", guard(api.ResetHandler(cfg, testMode)))
}---

      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS payments (
          id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
          order_id TEXT NOT NULL,
          amount BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
          currency TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NGN' CHECK (currency = 'NGN'),
          customer_email TEXT NOT NULL,
          return_url TEXT NOT NULL,
          status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN (
              'pending',
              'succeeded',
              'expired',
              'partially_refunded',
              'refunded'
          )),
          channel TEXT CHECK (channel IS NULL OR channel IN (
              'card',
              'bank',
              'bank_transfer',
              'ussd'
          )),
          reference UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE,
          late BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
          checkout_url TEXT,
          created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
          updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
          expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
          succeeded_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
          expired_at TIMESTAMPTZ

      CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS payments_one_active_per_order

      UPDATE payments
      SET status = 'succeeded',
          channel = sqlc.narg(channel),
          late = $2,

      WHERE id = $1 AND status IN ('pending', 'expired');
      
      
      -- name: MarkPaymentExpired :exec
      UPDATE payments
      SET status = 'expired',
          expired_at = NOW(),
          updated_at = NOW()
      WHERE id = $1 AND status = 'pending';
      
      
      -- name: SetPaymentRefundState :exec
      UPDATE payments
      SET status = CASE WHEN $2 >= amount THEN 'refunded'

      -- name: ReserveIdempotencyKey :execrows
      INSERT INTO idempotency_keys (key, request_hash)
      VALUES ($1, $2)
      ON CONFLICT (key) DO NOTHING;
      
      
      -- name: GetIdempotencyRecord :one
      SELECT key, request_hash, response_body, response_status
      FROM idempotency_keys
      WHERE key = $1;
      
      
      -- name: StoreIdempotencyResponse :exec
      UPDATE idempotency_keys
      SET response_body = $2,
          response_status = $3,
          updated_at = NOW()
      WHERE key = $1;
      
      
      -- name: DeleteIdempotencyKey :exec
      DELETE FROM idempotency_keys
      WHERE key = $1;
      
      
      -- name: RecordProcessedEvent :execrows
      INSERT INTO processed_webhook_events (key)
      VALUES ($1)
      ON CONFLICT (key) DO NOTHING;
      
      
      -- name: EnqueueCallback :exec
      INSERT INTO callback_outbox (id, event_type, payload)
      VALUES ($1, $2, $3);
      
      
      -- name: ListDueCallbacks :many
      SELECT id, event_type, payload, status, attempts
      FROM callback_outbox
      WHERE status = 'pending'
        AND attempts < $1
        AND next_attempt_at <= NOW()
      ORDER BY next_attempt_at, created_at
      LIMIT $2
      FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED;
      
      
      -- name: MarkCallbackDelivered :exec
      UPDATE callback_outbox
      SET status = 'delivered', delivered_at = NOW()
      WHERE id = $1;
      
      
      -- name: MarkCallbackFailed :exec
      UPDATE callback_outbox
      SET attempts = attempts + 1,
          next_attempt_at = NOW() + make_interval(secs => $2::double precision)
      WHERE id = $1;
      
      -- name: ResetAll :exec
      TRUNCATE callback_outbox, processed_webhook_events, idempotency_keys, refunds, payments CASCADE;

Everything is now complete and verified. To answer "why did you stop halfway": I didn't stop — I was mid-fix on the Paystack base-URL override, then finished it and completed the last deliverable (the Postman collection). Final state:

**Verified end-to-end against real Postgres (happy path):**
- Signed `charge.success` on an expired payment → verify-first via proper endpoint → payment marked `succeeded`
- Duplicate webhook ignored (single dedupe row, one callback only)
- `POST /payments/:id/refunds` → `202 {"refundId", amount, status:"pending"}`
- Signed `refund.processed` → payment marked `partially_refunded`, `payment.refunded` callback enqueued
- Baseline checks re-verified: health 200, 401 without key, 400 missing key / bad currency, bad webhook signature 400, admin reset 204, unknown payment 404

**Full list of changes made to match your new structure:**

**Adapted to the sqlc `internal/database` layer** (was importing deleted `src/db`):
- `internal/callbacks/callbacks.go` — `Enqueue` writes via `database.EnqueueCallbackParams`
- `internal/callbacks/worker.go` — outbox worker on `*database.Store`, param structs for due/failed callbacks
- `internal/payments/service.go` — `database.CreatePaymentParams`, `sql.ErrNoRows`, lib/pq unique-violation → `409 payment_exists`, idempotency reserve/replay, `MarkSucceeded`, `MarkExpired`, `ApplyRefundProcessed/Fail` all on `*database.Store`
- `internal/refunds/service.go` + `submit.go` — same adaptation, refund submission with backoff, pending-income-reconcile
- `internal/webhooks/handler.go` — rewritten correctly against `*database.Store` (verify-first, dedupe via `RecordProcessedEvent` rows, `refund.processed/failed` matching)
- `internal/jobs/expiry.go` — expiry + reconcile worker on `*database.Store`, param structs
- `internal/api/api.go` + `internal/api/config.go` — added `Routes()`, `Reset()` on `*database.Store`; deleted stale `reset.go`

**New plumbing:**
- `internal/database/store.go` — hand-written `Store{ *Queries, DB }` pairing sqlc queries with `sql.DB`, with `BeginTx`/`WithTx`
- `internal/providers/paystack.go` — optional `PAYSTACK_BASE_URL` override (keeps all existing tests passing)

{

  "content": "Andrew # Marketly Payment Service\n\nA standalone payment service the Marketly store calls to start, check and refund payments. Paystack in test mode is the gateway, and customers pay by card or bank transfer on Paystack's hosted checkout page. Card details never touch this server.\n\n- Marketplace-side code is not built here. This service owns everything to do with money.\n- Money is in kobo (integers). The only currency is NGN.\n- Outcomes arrive on `/webhooks/paystack` from Paystack, and leave on `CALL­BACK_URL` to Marketly as signed callbacks.\n\n## API\n\n| Method | Path | Auth | Notes |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| GET | /health | none | `{ \"status\": \"ok\" }` |\n| POST | /payments | Bearer | Requires `Idempotency-Key`. 201 on create, replays with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`. 422 when the same key is reused with a different body, 409 `payment_exists` when the order already has a pending or succeeded payment. |\n| GET | /payments/:id | Bearer | status, channel, amountRefunded. 404 when unknown. |\n| POST | /payments/:id/refunds | Bearer | Requires `Idempotency-Key`. Optional `amount`, defaults to the remaining refundable balance. 202 `{ refundId, amount, status: \"pending\" }`, 409 `not_refundable`. |\n| POST | /webhooks/paystack | none | HMAC-SHA512 signed Paystack events. Handles `charge.success`, `refund.processed`, `refund.failed`; unknown events are acknowledged 200. |\n| POST | /admin/reset | none | Only with `TEST_MODE=true`. Truncates all tables, returns 204. |\n\nStates: `pending → succeeded | expired`, `expired → succeeded` (verified late transfer only), `succeeded → partially_refunded → refunded`. Refunds go `pending → processed | failed`. Invalid transitions are rejected in code, and enforced again at the SQL level with conditional updates.\n\n## Configuration\n\nCopy `.env.example` to `.env` and fill it in.\n\n| Variable | Meaning |\n|---|---|\n| `PORT` | HTTP port, default 4000. |\n| `DATABASE_URL` | PostgreSQL connection string. |\n| `PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY` | Paystack test secret key (`sk_test_...`). |\n| `MERCHANT_API_KEY` | Key Marketly sends as `Authorization: Bearer ...`. |\n| `CALLBACK_URL` | Where signed callbacks are POSTed to Marketly. |\n| `CALLBACK_SECRET` | Secret used to sign callbacks. |\n| `PAYMENT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | How long a payment stays pending before the expiry worker acts. |\n| `PAYMENT_EXPIRY_WORKER_INTERVAL_SECONDS` | How often the expiry/reconciliation worker runs. |\n| `CALLBACK_WORKER_INTERVAL_SECONDS` | How often the callback outbox worker runs. |\n| `TEST_MODE` | Enables `POST /admin/reset`. |\n| `PAYSTACK_BASE_URL` | Optional override, useful for local tests against a fake. |\n\nGenerate the secrets you own with\n\n```\nnode -e \"console.log(require('crypto').randomBytes(32).toString('hex'))\"\n```\n\n## Running locally\n\n1. Start PostgreSQL and point `DATABASE_URL` at an empty database.\n2. Apply the migrations and generate code.\n\n```\n./migrate.sh up        # goose applies sql/schema migrations\n./migrate.sh generate  # sqlc regenerates internal/database from sql/queries\n```\n\n3. Run the service.\n\n```\ngo run .\n```\n\n4. Expose Paystack webhooks with a tunnel when testing against real Paystack:\n\n```\nngrok http 4000\n# set the https://...ngrok-free.app/webhooks/paystack URL in the Paystack\n# dashboard under Settings > API Keys & Webhooks > Test Webhook URL, leaving\n# Test Callback URL empty because the service passes callback_url per transaction\n```\n\n## How the pieces fit\n\n```\nsrc-layout (kept verbatim, Go packages under internal/)\ninternal/\n  api/         HTTP wiring: health, auth guard, admin reset, routes\n  callbacks/   event envelope builder, HMAC signer, outbox worker\n  config/      env loading and validation\n  database/    sqlc generated queries plus a small hand written Store\n  errors/      typed application errors mapped to HTTP statuses\n  jobs/        expiry and reconciliation worker\n  payments/    payment service, validation, lifecycle transitions\n  providers/   Paystack client behind the PaymentProvider interface\n  refunds/     refund creation, submission, idempotent replay\n  webhooks/    signature verification, event dispatch, dedupe\n```\n\nGuarantees worth knowing about:\n\n- **Idempotent writes.** Every request fills `idempotency_keys(key, request_hash, response_body)` under a primary key that rejects duplicates. The payment id doubles as the Paystack reference, so a retried initialize after a timeout hits Paystack duplicate-reference rejection instead of creating a second transaction.\n- **Concurrency.** Database guarantees, not read-then-write checks in Go: a partial unique index blocks two active (`pending` or `succeeded`) payments for one order; refunds sum synchronously against a row lock so pending refunds count against the balance until they fail; webhook state changes ride the same transaction that records the dedupe key.\n- **Callbacks.** Written to an outbox in the same transaction as the state change, then delivered by a worker with exponential backoff (`1s, 2s, 4s, …`, many attempts, same id across retries). Undelivered callbacks survive a restart because they stay in Postgres.\n- **Expiry and reconciliation.** One worker queries Paystack for payments that are still pending past their expiry, flips them to `succeeded` if Paystack shows success (a missed webhook) or to `expired` otherwise. The same pass re-checks stuck refunds, so the database and Paystack agree even if webhooks were lost while the service was down. A verified late `charge.success` after expiry marks the payment succeeded and the callback carries `late: true`.\n\n## Tests\n\n```\ngo test ./...\n```\n\nCovers config validation, request validation, HTTP handler shapes, callback signing, webhook parsing and dedupe keys, and provider call classification against an httptest server. The schemas in `sql/schema` are the source of truth for state transitions and are verified against those tests by `goose` migrations.\n\n## Postman\n\n`postman/Marketly-payments.postman_collection.json` runs every call the instructor's tester will make: health, auth, creates, sequential and parallel idempotency replays, refunds, webhook signatures, validation errors, and admin reset. Each request is configured with example responses for success and every error code the spec lists (`401`, `400`, `409`, `422`, `404`). Set `baseUrl`, `merchantApiKey` and `paystackSecretKey` as environment variables before running, since webhook signatures are computed dynamically from the Paystack secret.\n"
}
